maxwell markham.name: Maxwell Markham
maxwell markham.origin: ===Origin=== left|thumb Maxwell "Crazy Max" Markham was a professional wrestler whose brutal tactics caused J. Jonah Jameson to write a scathing editorial calling for an investigation by the wrestling commission. As a consequence of the hearings, his license was revoked. Ten years later, he obtained from the Jackal an exoskeleton grizzly bear suit that augmented his strength and durability. He used this suit to attack the Daily Bugle in an attempt on revenge against Jameson for ruining his wrestling career, but Spider-Man defeated him. The Grizzly then attempted to defeat Spider-Man alongside the Jackal, but was defeated again by Spider-Man and went to prison. ===Rematch=== After his release, Markham took his exoskeleton grizzly bear suit to the Tinkerer for an upgrade. Markham demanded a rematch with Spider-Man so that he could take revenge on Spider-Man and save face among his peers. Spider-Man faked a defeat, allowing the Grizzly to think that he defeated him and thus boost his confidence. left|thumb ===The Spider-Man Revenge Squad=== He became a member of the Spider-Man Revenge Squad along with the Kangaroo, the Gibbon, and the Spot, but the group became better known as the "Legion of Losers". Planning only to get revenge on Spider-Man, the Grizzly and the Gibbon were shocked to see the Kangaroo and the Spot robbing a bank. They did capture Spider-Man but released him, claiming that "He's an all-right guy". The Grizzly and the Gibbon teamed up with Spider-Man to capture the Kangaroo and the Spot. The Grizzly and the Gibbon later became crime-fighters and helped Spider-Man (disguised as the Bombastic Bag-Man this time) again to stop the White Rabbit's bank robbery. ===Going Straight=== At one point, out on probation, he tried to turn his life around. His desire to keep wearing his exoskeleton grizzly bear suit, several accidents and the interference of his criminal friends made his life that much more miserable. ===Secret War=== When he was suspected of having his exoskeleton grizzly bear suit upgraded secretly, the Grizzly was interrogated by S.H.I.E.L.D. and revealed that the Tinkerer had done just that. ===Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg & Holliway=== The Grizzly hired Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg & Holliway after he was accused of a robbery at Madison Square Garden. He worked with the She-Hulk, as his defense was to be that he had been seen fighting Power Pack in New Jersey at the same time. The Grizzly, on leaving Timely Plaza, was attacked by Starfox, who did not understand that the She-Hulk's employers had taken the villain on as a client. The Grizzly was knocked out by Starfox. ===Hammerhead=== The Grizzly worked as an enforcer for Hammerhead. With a new costume, fangs and claws; he teamed up with Boomerang. At one point he claimed to have a son (name unknown) and that he used his son's college fund to pay for the fangs and claws. ===The Hood's Gang=== The Hood sent the Grizzly to kill the Punisher. However, the Grizzly walked into a trap, with nothing but explosives waiting for him, which the Punisher's assistant then detonated. The Grizzly somehow survived the explosion. ===Kraven's Zoo=== Alyosha Kravinoff began collecting a zoo of animal-themed superhumans, including the Grizzly, the Gargoyle, Tiger Shark, the Kangaroo, Aragorn (the Black Knight's winged horse), the Vulture, the Mongoose, the Man-Bull, Dragon Man, Swarm, the Mandrill, Bushmaster, the Leap-Frog, and the Rhino. In the end, the Punisher managed to sabotage this zoo; though Kraven himself escaped to the Savage Land. ===Stephen Colbert=== Stephen Colbert was a candidate for President of the United States who ran on a third party. Colbert noticed how few people were in the crowd. He gave up and took off his jacket and tie and was Stephen Colbert no more. He saw Spider-Man battling the Grizzly. He tried to help, but Spider-Man told him that it was not his fight. Spider-Man took him to a nearby building and then continued his battle with the Grizzly. Colbert pushed a statue off the building and it hit the Grizzly on the head. Spider-Man thanked him for his help and gave him a ride home. In the end he won the popular vote, but lost to Barack Obama in the electoral votes. left|thumb ===The Thunderbolts=== The Grizzly was recruited by Norman Osborn and inducted into the Thunderbolts. He also underwent a number of augmentation procedures and now possessed superhuman powers without the use of his exoskeleton grizzly bear suit. During this time, the Grizzly started wearing a coat with a bear-shaped hood on it instead of his usual exoskeleton grizzly bear suit. He and the team went on a mission against the Agents of Atlas. The Grizzly was also made the commander of a squadron of B.A.T.F.E. agents. He was with the team when they battled Spider-Woman. The Grizzly also joined the team in their mission to retrieve Gungnir, the spear of Odin, during the Siege of Asgard. He and the other Thunderbolts were betrayed by Ant-Man (Eric O'Grady). ===The Raft=

During this time, the Grizzly started wearing a coat with a bear-shaped hood on it instead of his usual exoskeleton grizzly bear suit. He and the team went on a mission against the Agents of Atlas. The Grizzly was also made the commander of a squadron of B.A.T.F.E. agents. He was with the team when they battled Spider-Woman. The Grizzly also joined the team in their mission to retrieve Gungnir, the spear of Odin, during the Siege of Asgard. He and the other Thunderbolts were betrayed by Ant-Man (Eric O'Grady). ===The Raft=

maxwell plumm.name: Maxwell Plumm
maxwell plumm.origin: Maxwell Plumm was a building contractor in New York City. He was indebted with crime boss Dominic Varone. To pay his debts, he was forced to perform budget cuts in his projects (including sub-standard materials and security practices), which caused different security failures. Of course, he kept it as a secret to his employees. Eventually, two of his construction workers fell to their deaths due to a sudden wind slipping the cable of a girder. A surviving worker was Jake Mallard, brother of the two victims. Mallard discovered Plumm's illicit activities and swore to get revenge on him. He made some construction-tool-like weapons and used a secret identity as the Steeplejack. The Steeplejack tried to kill Plumm by throwing him from the top of one of his buildings. However, Power Man was coincidentally near the area, witnessing the scene, and rushed to save Plumm. After exchanging some punches, the Steeplejack threw Plumm from the building, and Power Man had to save him. Plumm was knocked down because of the fight. However, when the police arrived (and the Steeplejack was long gone), Plumm awoke and hired Power Man as bodyguard. He did not explain Power Man the motivations of Steeplejack - although Steeplejack himself would. During a second fight with Power Man, Steeplejack used advanced weaponry but was nevertheless defeated and killed. However, Plumm noticed the Steeplejack's gear and found it interesting, so he salvaged and reproduced it; he wanted to patent and sell Mallard's inventions. He relocated to Boston, he also began a new project, Monarch Plaza, and continued his budget-cutting tactics. This new project involved a worker named Joseph Danvers, who was the father of super-heroine Ms. Marvel (Carol Danvers). Due to Plumm's illicit activities, Danvers was almost killed by the impact of materials thrown by a wind - and he would have died if his daughter were not there to save his life. Joe Danvers threatened Plumm because of the event, but Plumm counter-threatened Danvers. Danvers, suspicious of Plumm, decided to investigate him and asked his friends from NOW Magazine to research about his past. Through this means, Danvers discovered Plumm's debts with organized crime and his budget cuts. She reported him to the authorities. Meanwhile, Plumm disguised as the second Steeplejack. He had a slighter build than Mallard, and thus he could fool no one pretending to be the original Steeplejack. However, he designed a completely-different costume, and other weaponry. He used it to kidnap Joe Danvers and intended to throw him from the Monarch Plaza. He was unaware of Ms. Marvel's seventh sense, that alerted her. Ms. Marvel flew to rescue his father, but was forced to knock Joe down to stop Joe from fighting the Steeplejack. Ms. Marvel had read about the original Steeplejack and recognized the weapons, but she probably never saw any picture, because she thought Plumm was the first Steeplejack. Soon she noticed that Plumm did not speak like school-dropout Mallard, and that he had a firstly-unseen padded costume. She then discovered the Steeplejack's secret identity. The Steeplejack tried to slam Ms. Marvel to an elevator he had filled with dynamite, and then cut the cable. However, Ms. Marvel simply flew back to the battle. The Steeplejack tried rapid-succession fire, and due to this he sent debris towards the dynamite. He caused an explosion that levelled the building and stunned him enough to be captured by Ms. Marvel. Plumm probably went to jail after that, but he eventually escaped or was freed. He was then contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former customed criminal turned into business agent for criminals. Gilbert was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing customed criminals such as Gilbert and Plumm. Gilbert organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter-attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door - even although the Steeplejack protested at this. However, the Scourge infiltrated the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all seventeen criminals (including Plumm) wielding a cut-down .50 submachine gun in each hand.

maxwell taylor.name: Maxwell Taylor
maxwell taylor.origin: Max and his older brother Hugh Taylor were the sons of the wealthy General Orwell Taylor. When Hugh got out of the Army he went to go work at the Vault but he was murdered by Venom. Orwell Taylor swore revenge and gathered Max, Hugh's army buddy Samuel Caulkin, and three of Hugh's friends from his job at the Vault. Together they formed the Jury and began to hunt Venom in an attempt to put him on trial. Max took the codename Screech and was given a suit of armor. Later they kidnapped Spider-Man and put him on trial for his role in bringing the Venom symbiote to earth. Eventually Max's father was revealed as corrupt and willing to make side deals with shady organizations like the Life Foundation. Max rejected his father when Orwell was willing to leave the other members of the Jury to die. Max gave up the Screech identity and then refined the Jury's trial process. A man known as Gavel was appointed as the judge for their trials. Olivia Lentz was recruited as the organization's prosecutor whose job was to present the case against the offender. Max served as defense lawyer to the accused. Max apparently broke ties with the Jury after they lost their funding.

maya hansen.name: Maya Hansen
maya hansen.origin: ===Extremis=== Dr. Maya Hansen was a brilliant scientist working for the FuturePharm Corporation in Austin, Texas alongside Dr. Aldrich Killian. Together they developed Extremis, an attempt to create a new super soldier. The Extremis was a techno organic virus that completely rewrites the body’s genetic code. It replaced entire organs making them more efficient. The virus also gave the body a sort of healing factor. The original Extremis granted superhuman strength, speed, endurance, reflexes and the ability to project electricity and breathe fire. When the samples were stolen and given to domestic terrorists, Maya contacted Tony Stark, with whom she had studied with in college. Later it was revealed that she was the one who let the samples go. After a brief period in jail, Tony broke her free just to fix his brain. Later she was paroled and worked under Tony at S.H.I.E.L.D.. ===Mandarin=== After the death of their mentor, Sal Kennedy, Maya blamed Tony and left S.H.I.E.L.D. to instead go to work for a man calling himself Tem Borjigin who was in fact the Mandarin, masquerading as the CEO of a company called Prometheus Gentech, Inc., whom she believed to have been contracted by the Defense Department. Together they worked on perfecting Extremis so it could be used to heal as Maya had wanted, as well as creating the next wave of Captain America type Super-Soldiers. After a short time working on the project Maya began to suspect that something wasn't right and contacted Jack Kooning who was running the government side of the project to confront him, only to learn he had no idea about the lengths the project had gone to, including making an airborne version of Extremis which was almost 100 percent lethal. Maya discovered a lab full of human subjects and was confronted by the Mandarin who admitted that he was planning on killing billions so the few million who survived would be made greater by Extremis. Moments after this, Tony arrived in an older model Iron Man armor and a fight ensued, culminating in the destruction of the facility by S.H.I.E.L.D. with an experimental localised black hole bomb. It replaced entire organs making them more efficient. The virus also gave the body a sort of healing factor. The original Extremis granted superhuman strength, speed, endurance, reflexes and the ability to project electricity and breathe fire. When the samples were stolen and given to domestic terrorists, Maya contacted Tony Stark, with whom she had studied with in college. Later it was revealed that she was the one who let the samples go. After a brief period in jail, Tony broke her free just to fix his brain. Later she was paroled and worked under Tony at S.H.I.E.L.D.. ===Mandarin=== After the death of their mentor, Sal Kennedy, Maya blamed Tony and left S.H.I.E.L.D. to instead go to work for a man calling himself Tem Borjigin who was in fact the Mandarin, masquerading as the CEO of a company called Prometheus Gentech, Inc., whom she believed to have been contracted by the Defense Department. Together they worked on perfecting Extremis so it could be used to heal as Maya had wanted, as well as creating the next wave of Captain America type Super-Soldiers. maya jackson.name: Maya Jackson
maya jackson.origin: Maya Jackson was a mutant whose powers developed faster compared to most people of her species. By the age of ten, she already possessed the ability to see through solid objects. Ever since she was little, Maya loved super heroes, and always wanted to be one. She was especially a big fan of Storm, to the point she collected any kind of pictures of Storm, and closely followed her personal life. When the M-Pox crisis broke out, Maya was visited by Iceman and Magik of the X-Men at her family's home in Philadelphia, and she was offered the chance to move to the safe zone of X-Haven in Limbo. Maya's mother refused to leave her home, so the X-Men left her a communicator in case they changed their mind. Maya later fell ill to M-Pox, and when their neighbors discovered she was a mutant, they decided to leave for X-Haven. Even though she was ill, Maya saw a silver lining in going to X-Haven, believing that she was going to meet her idol and become an X-Man. Unfortunately, Maya's condition had worsened to the point not even mutant healers could help her, and the X-Men were so busy Storm could never find time to be introduced to Maya. On her deathbed, Maya's sister, Alisha, rushed to try and get Storm to meet Maya. She was successful, and Storm talked with her. A few moments before she died, Maya was officially made a member of the X-Men under the alias she had created for herself, Lucid.

maya lopez.name: Maya Lopez
maya lopez.species: Human; ward of the Kingpin with a talent for mimicking actions
maya lopez.origin: ===Early Life=== Maya was born deaf, but due to her incredible lip reading abilities, she wasn't diagnosed for a long time. Her father, William Lincoln, was a Native American of the Cheyenne Nation and secretly a mob enforcer working for the Kingpin. They were good friends, but, at one point, he outlived his purpose and Kingpin decided to gun him down. As Kingpin was about to shoot him, he used his last words to ask that he take care of Maya. When she found her dying father, he reached out to her, leaving a bloody handprint on her face. left|thumb|200px|Maya with a bloody handprint Maya was then taken in by Fisk and placed in a school for kids with special needs, but after using her skill to duplicate a song from a piano recital, Kingpin enrolled her in school for the the gifted instead. She particularly enjoyed art and dance. ===Echo=== Fisk used her in one of his plots to destroy Matt Murdock, who he knew was the vigilante called Daredevil. First, he arranged for Matt to meet her, knowing Matt was lonely after the recent death of Karen Page, and then he tricked Maya, by convincing her that Daredevil was her father's killer. 180px|thumb|right|Learning Daredevil's identity Focused on getting revenge, Maya watched videos of Bullseye and Daredevil fighting and faced him in combat, proving herself to be more than a match for the devil. Matt recognized her scent and tried to pull his punches, not understanding why she was attacking him, but she was merciless. She managed to subdue him and pulled a gun to end him, revealing her reasons in the process. Luckily there were a few kids watching the whole scene and she left, leading the children to believe it was all a play. They faced each other two more times, before Matt was finally able to explain himself, leading Maya to brutally shoot the Kingpin, blinding him in the process. ===Vision Quest=== Maya left the country to travel the world and rediscover herself, visiting the art museums wherever she went. After months away, she returned to New York to reconcile with Matt, only to find he was already with another woman. She then left New York to go to her father's reservation and visited the Chief who was the old medicine man that she and her father would visit when she was younger. After listening to his stories about her father, Maya decided to follow his suggestion and went on a "vision quest". She went to the woods to fast and meditate to receive visions which she hoped would provide her with some answers on what to do next with her life. On the fourth day of her "vision quest" during a thunderstorm she was startled by what she believed to be an animal spirit and briefly fought him. Once she realized her mistake they talked and she shared some of the visions she received. When she got to her final vision about "two dogs fighting", he ended up telling her a story about it. This ultimately motivated her to start telling stories just like her father did. She went back to New York and began to perform in the theater using sign language, dance, and music. She spoke with Matt again who said that he attended her first performance titled "Parts of a Hole" and that he would see "The Echo Story" with a friend. He made no attempt to stop her from kissing him because he knew it was a goodbye kiss. ===Ronin and the New Avengers=== Maya assisted the New Avengers after being recommended and referred by Daredevil to Captain America, using the ninja identity of Ronin. Murdock provided her with the necessary information on the Hand, Yakuza, and Silver Samurai before meeting with Captain America in a café to receive further instructions. It was in Japan that she infiltrated the Yashida Fortress, only to learn that the Hand and Hydra were now in a partnership, and were trying to influence Harada to join and lead them. Maya, however, was unsuccessful in trying to leave the fortress undetected, and was pursued by many of the Hand's ninjas. She respected Captain America's wishes by attempting to kill fewer of them, but in the end she was left with little choice. Upon returning to the Avengers penthouse in Japan where she had met earlier with Captain America, she quickly explained to him and the New Avengers what she had learned. The Hand, however, had followed her and once they had finally caught up, attacked her and her teammates. She fought alongside the New Avengers against them and arrested Madame Hydra. Maya then arranged with Captain America for her to stay in Japan and watch the Hand's activities, hoping to resolve the conflict between them and the Yakuza, and because she had discovered rumors that Elektra might currently be in power as the leader of the Hand. thumb|left|180px|As Ronin Maya was not heard of again until after the the passage of the Superhuman Registration Act and the consequent Superhero Civil War, and was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative. Though it was not discovered until later, she had been murdered in a fight with Elektra, who was indeed lead

fields.additional_attributes: Deafness: Being deaf poses a significant challenge for Echo in combat situations. While her photographic reflexes allow her to replicate physical movements flawlessly, her inability to hear leaves her susceptible to attacks or movements that rely on sound cues. Sneak attacks, distractions through noise, or strategies dependent on auditory signals can catch her off guard, giving her opponents an advantage.
equipment: Formerly the Ronin armor.
weapons: As Echo: Billy clubs similar to those Daredevil carries, handguns, poisoned darts and shuriken. As Ronin: She has two nunchaku and a katana.
fields.notes: The term "ronin" refers to a masterless samurai. The "Ronin" alias has been used by several others, including Clint Barton, Alexei Shostakov, and Eric Brooks.
fields.trivia: The outfit of Ronin was originally conceived by Marvel editor-in-chief Joe Quesada as a redesign for his co-creation, the character , at Valiant's request in preparation for a relaunch. After Valiant declined to use that design, Quesada repurposed it for Ronin.

maya thomas.origin: Maya Thomas went to the search for her father, Frederick Henry Thomas II who hadn't returned from a night out drinking. She found Wolverine, and the pair went to the bar he was last presumed to be at. After finding no leads, they went back to her house, where her father attacked Wolverine when he believed he was a person his wife, and Maya's mother, was having an affair with. After Wolverine injured Fred and he was taken away in an ambulance, Maya was with her mother when she thanked Wolverine.

mayari.origin: According to ancient myths, the Earth Mother Gaea gave birth to Bathala (Bathalang Maykapal), the supreme Sky Father and Diwatas' king. Later, Bathala fell in love with a mortal woman while visiting Earth and sired Mayari, goddess of the moon, among other deities. They devoted much of their time and energies to serving as guardians of nature.

fields.history: According to ancient myths, the Earth Mother Gaea gave birth to Bathala (Bathalang Maykapal), the supreme Sky Father and Diwatas' king. Later, Bathala fell in love with a mortal woman while visiting Earth and sired Mayari, goddess of the moon, among other deities. They devoted much of their time and energies to serving as guardians of nature.

maybelle parker.name: Maybelle Parker
maybelle parker.origin: ===Early life=== Born Maybelle Reilly, she came from a poor family where her parents constantly argued over money. Her father eventually left her and her mother blamed her for the troubles. It was her lack of money that attracted her to a wealthy young rogue named Johnny Jerome. He took her dancing and bought expensive clothes for her. She loved him and refused to hear the warnings from Ben Parker, who worked at Coney Island as a barker. Ben proved to be correct about Johnny after he held up a jewelry store. Johnny threatened to kill Ben, but he had to run off after the police neared May's home. He was arrested as he tried to escape. May soon fell for the responsible Ben. ===A family with Ben Parker=== Even after becoming a couple, May and Ben didn't always get along, and they broke up several times. After a big discussion, May and Ben ended their relationship; but three weeks later, they got back together and were married, much to May's friend Anna Watson's delight. May and Ben attempted to start a family but May had a miscarriage and was prevented from having another child when they discovered a cardiac anomaly. May also majored in Art History at college. thumb|left|Young Peter being left to May and Ben's care May and Ben took in their nephew Peter after the death of his parents and raised him. Ben immediately took to the role of the boy's father, but May was at first reluctant. She still remembered her parents blaming her own birth for the destruction of their marriage, and she was afraid that Peter might signal the end of her own marriage. In time, however, she warmed up to Peter, who unexpectedly strengthened the couple's marriage. The two loved Peter as their own son and were very happy together. Their marriage came to a tragic end one night during Peter's high school years when a burglar entered their house in an attempt to steal a cache of money hidden by a gangster before the Parkers bought the house. (Money which May and Ben had already discovered destroyed years earlier. ) After Ben's death, life became financially difficult for May and her nephew, with May going as far as pawning off her own jewelry for cash to stay afloat. Unbenknownst to May, Peter gained super powers at this time and began fighting crime as the masked hero Spider-Man. In order to help Aunt May financially, Peter took a job as a freelance photographer at the Daily Bugle newspaper, snapping photos of dangerous events and of Spider-Man. ===Raising a young man solo=== Despite his secret double-life as a capable super hero, May doted on Peter to an extreme, often cooking him food, baking him sweets, and worrying about his safety and health. This relationship ran both directions, however, with Peter often worrying about the health of his Aunt May. May's poor health resulted in her often becoming sick enough to require hospitalization or suffer heart attacks. A blood transfusion from Peter after one of May's illnesses caused radioactive particles to transfer into May's blood stream and later required a rare serum to be administered to heal her. With the family's lack of funds, Peter had to work extra hard and sell off many of his belongings to pay for May's medical bills. Peter's worry for her increased when May's regular family physician, Dr. Bromwell, eventually perscribed no shocks or excitement for May, something that was very at odds with Peter's lifestyle as a secret crimefighter. alt=Gwen confronting May|thumb|left|May coming to terms with the fact that her nephew is no longer a helpless child May did not have a great many friends, and following Ben's death combined with Peter's regular escapes to adventure in the city as Spider-Man, May often found herself lonely. May did, however, maintain at least one close friend: her neighbor Anna Watson. For a time, May and Anna had regular weekly get-togethers. May was also often trying to set Peter up with Anna's niece, Mary Jane. (A niece whom many years later Peter would end up marrying. ) Her nephew Peter eventually moved out on his own when May moved in with Anna. May feared and disliked Spider-Man. May's babying of Peter continued for years until a decisive confrontation with Peter's college girlfriend Gwen Stacy in which Gwen forced May to realize that Peter was a man and not a helpless child anymore. ===Doctor Octopus=== Meanwhile, Peter feared for his aunt's well-being and the fatal shock that could result if she ever learned about his career as Spider-Man. Peter was often torn between dealing with a major crisis while his aunt needed nearly constant care. This conflict took on a bizarre turn when Aunt May had his enemy, Doctor Otto Octavius (also known as Doctor Octopus), as an apparent sweetheart and even became ready to marry him; Peter struggled to deal with his enemy's game while not hurting his aunt. ===Nathan Lubensky=== For a while, after Peter moved out, May joined the Gray Panthers, a civil rights group for the elderly. While protesting at city hall, May had a heart

fields.personality: May Parker was notoriously strong-willed and spirited in her old age. ===Religious Views=== May partly influenced her nephew, Peter's, religious views, given that she had always been a devout Protestant Christian.
fields.additional_attributes: Heart Condition Breast Cancer: Aunt May suffered from cancer.
fields.notes: The character maintained a subtle undertone of inner strength until the departure from the title by co-creator Steve Ditko, after which her characterization leaned closer to stereotypical senility. This has been changed back and forth as other writers have handled the character. A "prototype version" of Aunt May appears in , published some months before
fields.trivia: Over the years she dated numerous different men including Doctor Octopus, Nathan Lubensky, and Willie Lumpkin. May Parker almost married Doctor Octopus. Aunt May was originally going to die instead of Gwen Stacy in . A curious note is that Mephisto's magic that altered Spider-Man's life in Brand New Day appears to have altered Spider-Man's history with the New Avengers and has shattered the connection between Jarvis and May. Even more of interest is that later events reveal Jarvis was some time in the past replaced by a Skrull (and a later confirmation it was indeed the Jarvis Skrull who had feelings for May), coupled with Mephisto's magic altering history, complicates matters. Added to this was Jarvis mentioning that he once courted May. Furthermore, in a What If alternate reality, without Mephisto's intervention, May claimed Jarvis was "shot", implying that she saw him die before her eyes, evidently not reverting back to Skrull form, which is even more confusing. As of Aunt May was estimated by Tracer's goggles to be 73. May was born on May 5th. Aunt May was in the same book club as Agatha Harkness.

fields.trivia: Over the years she dated numerous different men including Doctor Octopus, Nathan Lubensky, and Willie Lumpkin. May Parker almost married Doctor Octopus. Aunt May was originally going to die instead of Gwen Stacy in . A curious note is that Mephisto's magic that altered Spider-Man's life in Brand New Day appears to have altered Spider-Man's history with the New Avengers and has shattered the connection between Jarvis and May. Even more of interest is that later events reveal Jarvis was some time in the past replaced by a Skrull (and a later confirmation it was indeed the Jarvis Skrull who had feelings for May), coupled with Mephisto's magic altering history, complicates matters. Added to this was Jarvis mentioning that he once courted May. maynard murrel.name: Maynard Murrel
maynard murrel.origin: Maynard Murrel was a ruthless and notorious killer of the American Frontier, a man remembered in the town of Leadville, Texas as a man who was killed twice. When he was initially apprehended for murder he was tried and sentenced to death by hanging by Judge Elmer Higgins and a jury of his peers. Murrel was hung and seemingly killed, but unknown to all he only suffered a broken neck and pretended to be dead. When his body was to be buried, Murrel revealed that he was still alive to the graveyard groundskeeper threatening to kill him if he ever told anyone and disappeared into the night. Taking the threat seriously the groundskeeper buried an empty coffin and told nobody what he knew. Five years later, Murrel came back to Leadville to get revenge against those who sentenced him to death. Killing Ben Owen, one of the jurors who sentenced him and leaving a black gauntlet style glove at the murder scene. The killing alerted the interest of the masked hero known as the Black Rider and his friend, local rancher Jim Lathrop. Both made the Murrel connection and went to see Judge Higgins, but both arrived too late as Maynard had just murdered him leaving his trademark black glove at the scene. Murrel became more bold in his attacks, next appearing at the Golden Angel Saloon with a bomb intending to blow everyone up in the bar. However he was stopped by the Black Rider who wrestled the bomb from his hands and tossed it outside where it blew up safely, but in the confusion Murrel managed to escape. When the Black Rider and Lathrop went to Murrel's grave and dug up his coffin they found that it was empty. Murrel tried to gun them down, but fled when the Black Rider proved to be too much of a crack shot for him. He then appeared at the home of the caretaker for the graveyard just as the man finished telling the Black Rider and Lathrop what he knew. Although Murrel got the drop on the three men, the Black Rider proved to be a faster draw and shot Murrel dead. Murrel's corpse was buried in the the grave that had stood empty for him for the past five years.

maynard tiboldt.name: Maynard Tiboldt
maynard tiboldt.species: Human son of the original Ringmaster, Maynard uses a mind-controlling hat.
maynard tiboldt.origin: ===Early life=== Maynard Tiboldt is the son of Fritz Tiboldt, the former Ringmaster of the Tiboldt Circus during World War II. After his parents were executed for their failures in the U.S., Maynard, who did not share his parents' sympathy for Nazism, thus became leader of the circus, and decided to move it to America, far from the scene of Hitler's rise to power and his parents' deaths. There Maynard planned to begin a new, honest life. ===New Circus of Crime=== But once in America, Tiboldt learned that a relatively small circus such as his could not hope to compete with enormous troupes like the circus owned by Amos Jardine. Tiboldt had dreamed of making his circus a major success, but instead he could barely cover his expenses. Blaming Americans not only for ignoring his circus, but for his father's humiliating capture in America years before, Tiboldt decided to turn to crime: if Americans would not enrich him and his performers willingly, then they would be forced to do so. The key lay in the plans to the "nullatron," a machine designed by unknown scientists in Nazi-occupied lands whom the Red Skull had murdered. The Skull had then used the nullatron to take hypnotic control of Captain America, Sub-Mariner, and the original Human Torch, all of whom were eventually freed from its control. Fritz Tiboldt had managed to obtain the plans for the nullatron during the war, and they had been inherited by Maynard. Maynard Tiboldt now decided to put the principles behind the nullatron to his own uses. Using his own talent for electronics, Tiboldt adapted the nullatron plans so as to construct a small but powerful device, which he would conceal within his large ringmaster's hat, able to mesmerize an enormous crowd all at once. An entire audience, thus rendered helpless, could then be robbed at will by the circus troupe, and would have no memory of being robbed upon awakening. Tiboldt outlined his plans to the members of his troupe, some of whom had accompanied him to Europe, and others of whom had joined the troupe after it came to America. A good percentage of the troupe quit, refusing to turn to crime (Tiboldt hypnotized them so that they would not betray his plans to the police.) However, a surprising number of the circus members eagerly agreed to join Tiboldt in a life of crime, and they became the nucleus of what was later known as the Circus of Crime. The Ringmaster and his accomplices were imprisoned by the law several times, but rarely for long, given the difficulties of proving the charges against him since his victims usually had no memory of being robbed. Occasionally the Circus of Crime operated without the Ringmaster, either because he was in prison or because some members had become dissatisfied with his leadership. He always returned as their leader. He was defeated by the Hulk, Daredevil, Spider-Man (Peter Parker), and others. The Circus of Crime briefly decided to elect the Clown as their new leader, but they were defeated again by Spider-Man. The Ringmaster later gets a surgical-upgrade of his eyes, allowing him to use them to hypnotize people, from surgeons working for Devlin DeAngelo, which he used to hypnotize Bruce Banner. As "Martin Thraller", the Ringmaster used his hypnotic eyes while running for president of the United States (and managed to hypnotize Nick Fury into forgetting his own identity) until stopped by Deathlok. Later, they encountered Generation X. Later, Ringmaster enacted a plot to hypnotize the elderly into stealing for him, though this was foiled by Howard the Duck, and Talos the Untamed. The Circus of Crime returned to New York as the "Cirque de Nuit" to inaugurate the Hotel Metropol in a show where Ringmaster used his mind-control abilities to hypnotize the rich spectators of his show and stole from them. The two Hawkeyes, Clint Barton and Katie Bishop, used special glasses in order to be immune to Ringmaster's control and stopped the Circus, leaving most of their members heavily wounded. The Ringmaster was blinded for life when Katie shot two arrows in his eyes. They escaped in the boat where the Circus took the loot, making them appear as they were the thieves. He was at the table when the major crime organizations sanctioned hits on the Hawkeyes. He later tried to hypnotize Scarlet Witch into stealing jewelry under the guise of giving her psychological therapy only to be giving her actual therapy which is why Wanda returned for repeated sessions with him before finally turning him in. ===Larval Earth=== Ringmaster captured Spider-Man (Miles Morales) and Spider-Woman and used their Dimensional Travel Watch to open a portal to Earth-8311. He kidnapped supervillains from this reality, until he was confronted by Spider-Ham and teleported out his reality by the Web Watch. He and the anthropomorphic criminals were transported to Earth-28204 where Maynard used his abilities to mind control the villains to commit crimes across Manhattan. It warns that he will kidnap Mayor Allen and warns that if Captain America should try to stop him, the star-spangled hero would be killed. When they are caught by Sgt. Duffy they are assigned to floor cleaning duty. Once finished his task, Steve and James change into Captain America and Bucky to go and watch the mayor. Captain America and Bucky spend the entire night waiting in the lobby of the mayor's apartment building waiting for the Vulture. When it appears that he hasn't shown, they go up to the mayor's penthouse apartment and are shocked to find him missing from his bedroom .

Mayr read the scroll that the mute Outcasts presented to him and was shocked to see that they had captured Umar's enemy, Doctor Strange. Realizing how they could benefit, Mayr and his fellow guard eagerly took custody of the bound Strange but only seconds later the G'uranthic Guardian revealed that Strange's bonds were only an illusion. Strange took advantage of their surprise to blast them into unconsciousness before they could sound the alarm.

mayzen.name: Mayzen
mayzen.origin: Mayzen the Poetic was a grim one among the Ice Elves of Alfheim, and was even known as Mayzen the Brooding One. His mother died giving birth to him, and his father hated him, at the point that Mayzen spat on his grave after his death. He seemingly used to watch at his brethren and despise their joy, but was attracted to Elphane. One day, Elphane managed to force him to join them. That day, blood rained over Alfheim, and the Ano-Athox arrived, Thane killing Elphane and Mayzen in a single sword stroke.

mazerot.name: Mazerot
mazerot.origin: Lady Mazerot belonged to the Black Bile Clan, which were known as the lords of the Wild Hunt for their use of war dogs. She was married and had 13 sons, but her husband and 12 of her sons were killed in the many wars fought by the Dark Elves during the reign of Kraw the Uncontrollable. Her last surviving son was Malekith, and she assured the boy that he will not have to die as a soldier. During the Forty-Third Troll War, Mazerot sold Malekith to the undertaker Elves of the Southern Swamps, in exchange for food for her war dogs. As Malekith was taken away, Mazerot told him that she could not lose another son without gaining nothing for it. She consoled him that at least he would not have to be a soldier. Many years later, Malekith returned home. As he revealed herself, Mazerot tried to excuse herself for her wrongdoing. Malekith had his mother fed to her own dogs, then took the mantle of the Lord of the Wild Hunt.

mcgool.name: McGool
mcgool.origin: Not much is known about the man called Boss McGool. His actual occupation is unknown however he was responsible for purchasing meat for a Christmas dinner being prepared for local orphans. McGool bought the cheapest meat available and pocketed the rest of the money. When the poor quality meat caused the orphans to get sick, it raised the ire of the super-hero known as Moon Man who correctly suspected that McGool purchased bad meat. After terrorizing both McGool and his secretary, Moon Man coerced McGool's secretary into providing a confession. McGool, fearing incarceration, attempted to flee town by train. However, Moon Man tracked him down and turned him over to the authorities.

mcm xli.name: MCM-XLI
mcm xli.origin: MCM-XLI was one of a group of four space explorers who later assumed the names of Donar, Froh and Loga. MCM-XLI herself became known as Brunnhilde. Brunnhilde was the navigator of the nebula-cruiser known as the Tekeli-Li and was in command of a powerful artifact known as the Ring of the Nebulas. In December of 1941, Brunnhilde's ship crashed behind the Siegfried Line in Northern France, where it was soon discovered by a Nazi scientist named Werner Schmidt. Schmidt, better known as "Brain Drain", recovered the aliens and used the intense power of the Ring of the Nebulas to bend them to their will. Brunnhilde however, proved more willful than her male comrades and escaped from Brain Drain's clutches. She was present during a Nazi bombing in Paris, and although she survived. During the battle she returned to the trance state imposed by Brain Drain and was ordered to return to the base, the trance this time was so deep that she went to a tunnel destroyed by the bombings until Captain America rescued her from possible death by removing her the ring and return it to its usual state. However, she emerged from the wreckage with no knowledge of who she truly was. Brunnhilde met Captain America, who became instantly infatuated with her, and pledged to help her no matter what. Traveling with Cap's team the Invaders, Brunnhilde soon regained her memories and fought alongside them to free her friends from Brain Drain's control. During the course of the battle, both the Ring of the Nebulas and the Tekeli-Li were destroyed. Once freed from Brain Drain's mind control, the aliens realized that they could never return to the stars. Unwilling to remain abandoned on the planet Earth, they decided to take their own lives by diving into a pit of acid in Brain Drain's laboratory.

The device was partially successful, summoning Uluath's home, the City Below the Seas, as well as schools of Fishmen, but it was only with the unexpected arrival of Aegis that the Dread Uluath himself appeared. Unfortunately for McTavish, Uluath was defeated by Kid Kaiju and Aegis, and he, alongside the rest of Happyology, were captured and detained.

meat mother.name: Meat Mother
meat mother.origin: After Gorr travelled to far future, he began using the Pool of Forevers to abduct gods from across the timestream. After Gorr's death, several of these gods were left without homes and chose to settle in Asgard, while others sought out planets to preside over. When Thor the Avenger returned to the past, he brought back a group of gods to replace the original Sky Lords of Indigarr - who had been slaughtered by Gorr. Rose Father, became the leader of the gods, and together with The Choir, Our Lady of Comets, Meat Mother, and the Prince of Soot proceeded to terraform Indigarr from a desolate wasteland into a verdant garden, but as the eons passed they fell dormant and were assumed to have perished. Billions of years later, the Goddesses of Thunder awakened her and her brethern to help All-Father Thor fight against Loki, who had taken up the primordial symbiote All-Black. By the time they reached the battle, Loki had resurrected Gorr, who had reclaimed All-Black and was trying to drown Thor and Loki in its living abyss. The Sky Lords of Indigarr attacked Gorr, mockingly stating that they were his true legacy and helping the Goddesses of Thunder defeat him. However, Gorr revealed that his body had been a construct created by All-Black, taking over the primordial symbiote and using it to infect the very universe itself - attacking them with symbiote-infected planetoids.

After Gorr's death, several of these gods were left without homes and chose to settle in Asgard, while others sought out planets to preside over. When Thor the Avenger returned to the past, he brought back a group of gods to replace the original Sky Lords of Indigarr - who had been slaughtered by Gorr. Rose Father, became the leader of the gods, and together with The Choir, Our Lady of Comets, Meat Mother, and the Prince of Soot proceeded to terraform Indigarr from a desolate wasteland into a verdant garden, but as the eons passed they fell dormant and were assumed to have perished. mech.origin: Mech was a post-apocalyptic zealot living in a community in Mojave City, California were its members pretended to live in a dystopian world for fun. Some time after Hydra took over the United States, Mech stumbled upon Misty Knight on the road after her car had broken down. He offered to check out her car, and determined it wasn't an easy repair. After noticing Misty was trying to help hide a young Inhuman named Annie, Mech offered to help them seek refuge in his community, as it went ignored by most people. After making a stop to outfit Misty and Annie with the proper gear, Mech drove them to Mojave City and introduced them to his community, where Annie stayed. Misty would later go to assist other communities and bring more Inhumans to Mojave City. After numerous travels, Mech suggested she stayed for a little while longer.

mechadoom.name: Mechadoom
mechadoom.origin: Mechadoom was initially intended to be a new line of Doombot created by Kristoff Vernard using research that Doom had deemed too dangerous. Kristoff stopped work before completion but the robot continued to build and improve itself until it gained enough sentience to leave Castle Doom. It gave itself the name Mechadoom and set up its own Doombot production line, in an attempt to improve the AI of them, but failed. Instead, he set about capturing robots with advanced AI's and was able to capture several including, Machine Man, Jocasta and others. Mechadoom attempted to capture Misty Knight but she escaped and enlisted the aid of Deathlok. The two found Mechadoom's base and on the first infiltration Misty's arm was blown off but discovered the others who had been captured. Deathlok tried again on his own but Deathlok was surprise ambushed by Mechadoom and rendered inert. While Mechadoom revelieved his origin, Deathlok rebooted and was assisted by Misty, Fantastic Four, X-Men, and Vision in taking down his Doombots. Mechadoom's power source was destroyed and so surrendered. He threatened to self destruct but was convinced to stop by Deathlok, before Reed Richards was able to improve his programming. With no ties to anyone, he decided to become a base for technical support for cyborgs, but was destroyed by Ultron who was angry at being captive and experimented on.

mechamage.name: Mechamage
mechamage.origin: The Fantastic Four were looking for magic users to help a friend named Alissa Maloy. Mechamage was able to listen in on a phone conversation. The Fantastic Four then went to free Margali Szardos, who had been captured by Selene. Mechamage teleported herself to the scene and helped free Margali. Transported to Limbo, they began preparing to battle Selene and her demonic ally Blackheart. Mechamage temporarily disguised herself as Alissa using an illusion spell. In the subsequent battle Mechamage attacked Blackheart and was able to prevent him from stealing the others' souls. Hellstorm and Margali pledged to help Mechamage and Alissa fight evil as the Shadow Hunters. Mechamage joined Margali, Agatha Harkness, the Scarlet Witch, Dakimh the Enchanter, Khalid Inshallah, and Jules St. Thomas in attempting to banish the Ego spore from Earth, but were unsuccessful.

mechano.name: Mechano
mechano.origin: Mechano was an over-sized robot (approximately 30 feet tall) created inside the workshop of an old man named Mr. Hopkins and his young assistant Tommy Briggs. Mechano represented an astonishing achievement in the field of mechanical engineering, notably for the fact that he was comprised primarily of scrap metal and spare electronics. Hopkins and Tommy entered Mechano in the local Industrial Fair. At the fair, Mechano was exposed to a malfunctioning transformer and suddenly sparked to life. He began running amok, terrorizing innocent civilians.

medea.name: Medea
medea.origin: ===Early Life=== Medea was the daughter of King Aeëtes of Colchis and the dark magic goddess Hecate, was renowned for her formidable sorcery, being hailed as both a sorceress and a witch of immense power. ===Quest for the Golden Fleece=== Medea's involvement was pivotal in assisting Jason and the legendary Argonauts on their daring quest to obtain the Golden Fleece. Medea utilized her potent magic not only to safeguard Jason but also committed a harrowing sacrifice—her own brother—ensuring Jason's successful escape upon the triumphant return of Jason and the Argonauts. ===Tragic End=== Medea and Jason sought refuge together, establishing a life in Corinth where their union was sanctified in marriage. Their marital bliss resulted in the birth of two sons, Mermeros and Pheres, marking a period of apparent tranquility in their lives. However, the tides turned when Jason callously abandoned Medea, choosing another woman as his new consort. Consumed by rage and a thirst for retribution, Medea's vengeance knew no bounds. In a chilling act of retaliation, she committed an unspeakable atrocity, gruesomely ending the lives of her own beloved children and the intended bride of Jason. Craftily employing poisoned attire, Medea orchestrated a scheme that not only avenged her betrayal but also stripped Jason of any hope of securing heirs through his new union. ===Modern Age=== thumb|left|Death She was recruited into The Fist and was the one to launch The Fist's first official attack: starting a zombie outbreak in Chicago. She was opposed by Captain America, Elektra, and Spider-Man. The trio confronted her at ground zero and was able to prevent her army from leaving McCormick Place. Medea was confronted by Elektra, who managed to kill her and lift the curse.

medgar dupaul.name: Medgar DuPaul
medgar dupaul.origin: Medgar DuPaul, born poor, was forced to work for a living from the age of four. He eventually amassed a fortune, but by then he was an adult, regretting the loss of his childhood. Determined to enjoy playing in his old age, DuPaul went to a Delaware town to organize a sadistic game in which he hunted human beings on his sprawling estate in a Delaware town (The town was named Backwoods, USA by Spider-Man, but this was probably a nickname). To do so, DuPaul used high technology such as a "hoverdisc", flying bulls with sensors, and remote-controlled automatic guns. DuPaul bribed the local sheriff, Andrews, paying him $500 for each person he brought to him, especially if they were strong, unrelated, and preferably unidentified. The corrupt Andrews provided DuPaul with vagrants and the like. None of the victims escaped, and they were buried in shallow graves. However, the constant disappearances of supposed escaped prisoners alerted Andrews' deputy Sarah, who became suspicious and investigated on her own. New York superhero Spider-Man confronted the villain Magma in Virginia and, after the fight, was left without any clothes, money, cards or identification. He hitchhiked to Delaware, but there he was arrested by Sarah, for stealing food, and taken to the county jail, where he claimed to be named Jay Jameson. In the cell, Spider-Man bent a metal bar to intimidate other prisoners, but Sheriff Andrews saw him and separated him from the other prisoners, who were going to the county work farm, to take him to DuPaul; Sarah secretly followed them. DuPaul explained the plan and gave her the advantage. Spider-Man was careful not to use his powers so as not to attract attention. Sarah tried to arrest DuPaul, but Andrews surprised Sarah and handcuffed her. Spider-Man, discovering the graves and the kind of person DuPaul was, decided to return to DuPaul's mansion to stop him, knocking out Andrews and rescuing Sarah in the process. Sarah grabbed a gun and apprehended DuPaul as he attempted to flee. Sarah allowed "Jay Jameson" to go for saving her life, but only after verifying that there were no federal warrants out for him.

medula.name: Medula
medula.origin: Medula was a Deviant woman who lived in Deviant Lemuria. Several decades ago, she met a scientist who called himself Maelstrom and mated with him. However, Maelstrom was an Inhuman/Deviant hybrid who depised his mother's race because they had killed her. Feeling shame for having consorted with a Deviant, he soon fled from Medula. However, their mating had left Medula pregnant with their child, a son who she named Ransak. Medula never told Ransak who his father was but, before she died, she did tell him that his father was a good man. Years later, Ransak was one of the five beings captured by Maelstrom's minions whose kinetic energy was drained from them and used to restore Maelstrom to existence in the physical world. fields.notes: Although Ransak's mother was first mentioned (and named) in , an earlier version of her was mentioned in Maelstrom's entry in . According to that entry, Maelstrom had once been married to a Deviant woman named Noma with whom he had dallied and had a son. However, when Maelstrom's father, the Inhuman geneticist Phaeder, had fallen out of favor with the ruling body of the Deviants, both his mate (Maelstrom's mother Morga) and Maelstom's mate had been put to death and Maelstrom's (unnamed) son had been sent to the slave pens. Given that the Head Writer of that first OHotMU series, Mark Gruenwald, was one of the writers who had created Maelstrom, it seems likely that the information presented in that Handbook entry was the backstory that Mr. Gruenwald had created for Maelstrom. However, since "Noma" was never even mentioned in any story while "Medula" was, that left Roy Thomas as the writer who created Maelstrom's mother. The entry on the Deviants in states that Maelstrom had "mated with the Deviant Medula, but abandoned her, unaware that she was pregnant with his son, Ransak." However, this is inconsistent with the story in in which Maelstrom, although never having met his son and not knowing his name, clearly knew of his existence. I presume this means that Maelstrom abandoned Medula after learning that she was pregnant and never bothered to learn anything about her child or even if the child had survived.

medusa gorgon.name: Medusa (Gorgon)
medusa gorgon.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== The Gorgon sisters did not worship their grandfather Set, but instead the Olympian gods, and all three of them served as chaste priestesses of Athena . Deities in their own right, the Gorgons were among the most beautiful in the world, and Medusa was the comeliest. Medusa lived on the remote isle in the shadow of Atlas, Atlantis. Eventually, Medusa laid with Poseidon on Athena's very altar. Enraged, Athena transformed the Gorgon sisters into scaly hags with snakes for hair. All their descendants bore the same curse, creating the snake-haired Gorgons. ===Perseus=== During the 14th century BC, Perseus located the Gorgons' hermitage in the wilderness surrounded by the petrified victims. Using his shield's reflective surface, Perseus beheaded Medusa and subsequently used her head as a weapon. The Shield of Perseus was then imbued with Medusa's power, turning those who look in its eyes to stone. It was wielded by Hercules as part of his post-invulnerability armament. ===Medusa-Land=== After Medusa's death, her daughter relocated to the subterranean world below Olympia: Medusa-Land. Medusa's daughter, who took her mother's name, became the ruler of the city. ===Hercules=== Generations later King Kreon of Pylos sent Hercules to retrieve the gold of Medusa from the Isle of Fear. On the island he encountered Medusa, alive and well, concealing her face behind a hood. Hercules and the Argonauts ended up slaying her once again. With Medusa's death, Jason and all her prior victims reverted back to flesh. ===20th Century=== Some time later Medusa moved to Paris, France with her husband, a blind Greek man. He won an art competition by using one of Medusa's victims as an art piece. Years later Mr. and Mrs. Grey bought the cursed European castle with Medusa imprisoned inside. Mr. Grey unknowingly released Medusa from her prison, but she failed to turn to stone. Thinking that her own curse had been somehow lifted, Medusa looked at herself in the mirror turning herself to stone. ===Modern Age=== ====Medusa's Head==== In modern times the head of Medusa was found in an archaeological dig in Greece by J. Collins Stacy. He held on to the head for many decades, until it was stolen from him by Mr. Collins. Mr. Collins hired Marc Spector to recover the head of Medusa. Spector managed to recover the head but in a petrified state. ====Wolverine/Hercules==== More recently the original Medusa was brought back to life via the Hand's resurrection ritual alongside with a number of Ancient Greek monsters to be used by Matsu'o Tsurayaba against Wolverine and Hercules. Medusa's attack was unsuccessful and resulted in beheading. Ironically enough, her head was used as a weapon against another resurrected Ancient Greek monstrosity, the Kraken. 300px|right|thumb|Medusa sees the body Wade Wilson (Earth-616)|Deadpool got her. ====Dracula's Gauntlet==== Sometime thereafter Medusa returned, only to be beheaded by Dracula once again. He then used her visage to turn Shiklah to stone. Upon defeating Dracula after a fierce battle, Deadpool struck a deal with Medusa to reverse the petrification of his wife in exchange for helping her get a new body, which turned out to have previously belonged to Frankenstein's Monster.

medusalith amaquelin.species: Inhuman exposed to the Terrigen Mist as a child
medusalith amaquelin.origin: ===Early Childhood=== thumb|left|Medusa in her youth. Medusalith Amaquelin was the daughter of Inhuman nutritionists Quelin and Ambur, members of the House of Agon, the royal family of the Inhumans. Medusa and her younger sister Crystal were cousins to Black Bolt, his brother Maximus and their cousins Gorgon, Karnak and Triton. As an infant, Medusa was subjected to the Terrigen Mists which allowed her hair to become malleable to her mental commands. Medusa was betrothed to marry Black Bolt, who was slated to succeed the Inhuman throne, but due to Black Bolt's powerfully destructive voice, he was isolated from society for many years. Medusa was a resourceful and calculating child. During her youth she accepted a challenge by Maximus to see who could sneak into the royal throne room and sit upon the Inhuman throne without getting getting stopped by their parents. Medusa allowed herself to be caught sneaking around by her parents. Medusa then told them the game that they were playing and while Quelin and Ambur stopped Maximus, Karnak and Crystal dead in their path, Medusa quietly sat upon the throne winning the competition. ===Adolescence=== thumb|Black Bolt, Medusa, Karnak and Gorgon challenge the king. On Black Bolt's 19th birthday, his father Agon allowed his son to finally leave isolation now that he had found the discipline to never speak. It was here that Medusa was introduced to Black Bolt. When Maximus attempted to force his brother to speak to cause untold destruction in the hopes he could eventually claim the Inhuman throne, Medusa, Gorgon and Karnak stopped him. Black Bolt's voice caused the untimely death of his parents, and worsened his brother's madness after his brother nearly betrayed their people to the Kree. left|thumb|Medusa Their king, expressed interest in Medusa as a future Queen. She was also propositioned by Kadlec the Seeker, whose advances she violently rebuffed. He then accused her of being a traitor. She escaped with her cousins to New York. During that time, she gained sympathy for Maximus. They returned to Attilan to help put down the revolt of the Alpha Primitives. Young and headstrong, when the young Inhuman royals later learned that their ruler had hidden the Slave Engine, the Inhumans most powerful weapon, in order to usher in an age of peace, they boldly confronted him. This led to a battle between the king and Black Bolt. Because he was weakened from hiding the engine the king was easily defeated in combat by Black Bolt. Medusa then witnessed as Black Bolt to the Himalayan Mountains. Black Bolt disposed the king by uttering his name, devastating him in a powerful sonic blast and leaving him for dead. This shameful chapter in Inhuman history was then covered up, the former ruler referred to only as the "Unspoken". However this event would have far reaching consequences many years in the future. Black Bolt soon became ruler of the Inhumans. By the 1950s the advancement of the human race threatened to expose the hidden land of Attilan. mega tony.name: Mega Tony
mega tony.origin: Mega Tony is a scientist and former agent of M.O.D.O.K., the mercenary organization of the eponymous professional. Tony was one of M.O.D.O.K.'s elite operatives, together with the sorceress Terrible Eye, thief Batroc the Leaper, and the organization's newest recruit, Gwenpool. Shortly after Gwen overthrew their boss and became leader of M.O.D.O.K., Mega Tony and the other elite members were kidnapped by an army of Teuthidans. The aliens had invaded Earth looking for Gwen, who had allegedly killed a platoon of their soldiers, a mission she had actually taken the credit for. M.O.D.O.K's benefactor, Vincent Doonan, even assisted the aliens in kidnapping Gwen's allies for leverage. He felt Gwen's plan to deal with the invasion was too irresponsible and chaotic, and believed forcing Gwen to surrender to the aliens was a much more peaceful option. Gwen managed to defeat the Teuthidans and rescue her friends at the cost of M.O.D.O.K.'s mobile base. With the base and its equipment lost, as well as any ties with their backer surely cut, Mega Tony, Terrible Eye, and Batroc decided to dissolve M.O.D.O.K. and part ways, much to Gwen's dismay. Following an encounter with Arcade, Gwen advised Mega Tony to apply for a job at Parker Industries. After showing some of his inventions to the company's CEO, Peter Parker, Tony was hired on the spot. Mega Tony later reunited with the rest of the former M.O.D.O.K. agents in anticipation for M.O.D.O.K. Superior's return to Earth. He swore revenge upon them only for their collective might to scare him off.

megan daemon.name: Megan Daemon
megan daemon.origin: Megan Daemon was born to a Scottish clan with hereditary access to magic and "dark power". She was born in 1904. While her older sister Alisabeth was born on the Winter Solstice, Megan was born on the Summer Solstice. Alisabeth attempted her first occult ceremony during her first menstrual cycle, using Megan as an unwitting assistant. Megan did not know the purpose of the ritual, but their mother's mutilated corpse was discovered the following day. A few years, later Megam had her own fiest menstrual cycle. Alisabeth convinced her to take part in another occult ceremony, and this apparently caused the death of their father. Alisabeth soon abandoned her sister to travel across Continental Europe. In 1922, Megan had her 18th birthday. Alisabeth send her a tarot card deck as a gift. In 1925, Megan had her 21st birthday and became legally an adult. Alisabeth briefly returned, but she quarreled with their clan's elders and may have caused their disappearance. While Alisabeth was the clan's heiress, she voluntarily abdicated her rights in favor of Megan. Before leaving, Alisabeth delivered to Megan a crystal pendant in the form of a cat's skull, which would supposedly help Megan to improve her knowledge of the Dark Arts. By the 1930s, Megan was considered an eligible bachelorette. She met and rejected many suitors, who were primarily interested in her wealth. But she befriended Ian MacGinnis, a member of the Royal Scots Borderers. The two had a joined vacation in 1937. When they visited Stonehenge as part of the jouney, they encountered Alisabeth in the process of opening a gateway for the Outer Dark. Megan apparently tried and failed to stop her sister, but her memories of the incident were erased. She regained consciousness two weeks later, having traveled to the United States aboard the LZ 129 Hindenburg. Alisabeth tried to summon an emissary from the Outer Dark towards the Hindeburg, but she was shot and incapacitated by Ian. Megan then fought the Emissary, though their battle set the Hindeburg on fire. Megan and Ian escaped the fire, but Megan was not certain whether Alisabeth also survived.

Megan apparently tried and failed to stop her sister, but her memories of the incident were erased. She regained consciousness two weeks later, having traveled to the United States aboard the LZ 129 Hindenburg. Alisabeth tried to summon an emissary from the Outer Dark towards the Hindeburg, but she was shot and incapacitated by Ian. Megan then fought the Emissary, though their battle set the Hindeburg on fire. Megan and Ian escaped the fire, but Megan was not certain whether Alisabeth also survived.
weaknesses: Megan has nearly identical powers with her older sister Alisabeth, but she has not been able to defeat Alisabeth in either of two attempts at a magical duel. She has also served as a pawn in Alisabeth's schemes for much of her life.
fields.notes: Both Alisabeth and Megan are connected to the dimensional portals of the Outer Dark, but their story does not identify the demons who interact with them. Another story identified Kthara as the ruler of the Outer Dark. |
fields.trivia: In 1984, Chris Claremont was working on an unpublished graphic novel which depicted the elderly Megan Daemon fighting against her would-be family heirs, who were trying to absorb her magical powers while she was still alive. She recruited two mutant assistants with magical potential of their own to help her, two girls called Kitty Pryde and Illyana Rasputina. A preview of this story was published in Amazing Heroes #39, but the story was never completed.

megan frost.name: Megan Frost
megan frost.origin: Megan was the firstborn daughter of Scott and Emma Summers. She was the oldest of their four children, which included two twin sisters and younger brother Alex (named after their deceased uncle Havok). Her older half-siblings Rachel and Nathan were both deceased. As a child of two leaders of the X-Men, Megan began training in the use of her abilities from a very young age. She learned what it means to be a mutant in a world of hate and fear and grew very comfortable around both humans and mutants alike thanks to her upbringing at the Xavier Institute. As a teen, she witnessed her friends and family brutally attacked by a combination of Skrulls and many of the X-Men's former foes. She was part of a group of Xavier Institute children who were captured by Mister Sinister, and grew closer to Olivier Raven during their imprisonment. They were eventually rescued and returned to their relatively normal lives. As she grew older, she fell in love with Oli. After helping them for awhile, she joined his young team of mutants, GeNext.

megan gwynn.species: Half-Mutant/Half-Fairy (apparently) who is able to utilise magic
megan gwynn.origin: ===Origin=== Megan Gwynn, also known as Pixie, was raised by her grandparents in the small mining town of Abergylid in Wales. Her mutant powers manifested in a near-miss road accident involving her bicycle and another car. She could manifest rainbow-colored butterfly wings allowing her to fly with great maneuverability. ===Paragon Squad=== After enrolling at the Xavier Institute, Megan was assigned to the Paragons training squad under the tutelage of former New Mutant, Wolfsbane. When it was discovered that Wolfsbane had been in a romantic relationship with a student, Elixir, she left the school, and was replaced by her former teammate, Magma. left|thumb|200px|Megan with Wolfsbane Gwynn proved herself to be an amiable and cheerful student, and she fit in well with her squad. Following M-Day, nearly all of the Institute's students were depowered, leading to the dissolution of the school's training squads. Gwynn was one of only 27 students, along with her fellow former Paragons, Trance, Wolf Cub, and Match, to have retained their mutant abilities. Forty-two of Gwynn's former classmates were killed when a bus carrying several depowered students was ambushed. Among the confirmed deaths was Gwynn's fellow Paragon DJ. ===Limbo=== Pixie, along with Anole, Loa, Wolf Cub, Gentle, Rockslide, and Match, were told a frightening "ghost story" one night at the school by their fellow student, Blindfold. Pixie, frightened by the story, told Blindfold that she didn't like her anymore. Blindfold apologized to her and told her, "I'm sorry for your loss". It soon turned out that this tale wasn't a story at all, but rather a vision of things past and of things to come. The group was soon sucked down into the realm of Limbo, where they were immediately attacked by a mob of demons. Pixie stayed by Blindfold's side during the fight, and Blindfold cautioned Pixie and the others that Gwynn must not "fall into darkness". She used her powers for the first time, incapacitating several demons with her "pixie dust", causing them to suffer psychedelic hallucinations. She admitted to not knowing what they saw in their hallucinations. After Illyana Rasputin, now known as Darkchylde, saved the small group, she asked N'astirh to bring Megan to her. Despite her friends' trying to stop her, Megan gave into Darkchylde's request for a portion of her soul to create a Soulsword. Illyana then explained that the knife was actually a portion of Pixie's own soul, which is why her Souldagger was smaller than the original Soulsword. Black magic could now fill the hole left behind in the knife's creation, leaving Pixie no longer an innocent personality as well as changing a great portion of her hair black instead of the previous pink. left|thumb|180px|Learning magic from Illyana Pixie was taught a teleportation spell by Illyana. She teleported her and her friends to Belasco to stop him from torturing the rest of the team. She was then told that in order to save her friends she must use her knife to stab Belasco. Initially hesitant, Pixie followed through with her orders and lost more of her innocence by killing the villain. After defeating Belasco and escaping from Limbo, Pixie was officially made a member of the New X-Men. Pixie was sitting in the medical lab along with Dust and Nezhno where she revealed that when she was of age, Dr. Strange would tutor her in magic. She was questioned by Mercury about her age because Mercury was trying to find out who is the youngest mutant alive now that more mutants weren't being born. Hellion assumed she was the youngest because she was the most immature. Megan questioned Sooraya about her religion and gushed over how Nehzno protected her in Limbo. Later she participated in a training session with Wolverine where she made him see unicorns. Pixie, along with the other New X-Men, took part in a battle against the Acolytes when they attacked the mansion seeking the Destiny Diaries. Blindfold later stated that Pixie would soon be injured. ===Messiah Complex=== When the first new mutant since M-Day appeared, Pixie joined X-23, Hellion, Anole, Surge, Armor, and Rockslide in attacking the Washington, D.C. base of the Purifiers by teleporting them there. They were opposed by Lady Deathstrike and the Reavers. When Julian was injured and the Reavers were about to attack, Pixie panicked and couldn't teleport the team out until Rictor, who had infiltrated the Purifiers as a spy, told her to concentrate or else they would all die. Pixie did so, but blindly teleported the team, scattering them between Washington, D.C. and the Xavier Institute. Injured, she mentally called out to Emma Frost, breaking Emma's concentration on the fight between a group of X-Men and the Marauders. right|thumb|200px|Pixie with her New X-Men Costume Later, back at the mansion, she was with several other students and Beast when Predator X attacked several students outside, then changed tactics to go after the weaker wounded students in the infirmary. megan jeda.first_appearance: Black Panther: The Most Dangerous Man Alive! Vol 1 523.1
megan jeda.origin: Megan Jeda was a girl from Hell's Kitchen who was rescued by the Black Panther during a hostage situation in a bank robbery. She was targeted by a serial killer who killed the people the Black Panther had saved, using a dating site. The serial killer was actually T'Challa's half-brother, Hunter the White Wolf, who killed the people T'Challa had saved to get his attention. Black Panther and Sofija managed to arrive in time before Hunter showed up at Megan's house as he had planned.

megan kinney.name: Megan Kinney
megan kinney.origin: Megan was the daughter of Deborah Kinney and the niece of Sarah Kinney. When Megan was young, she liked to send drawings to her Aunt Sarah, although she had never met her. Debbie also enclosed photos of Megan for Sarah to see. Megan was abducted by a serial child molester, and Sarah got X-23, the adolescent clone of Logan and assassin-in-training, to help track her down, sneaking her out of the Facility to do so. X-23 tracked the kidnapper by scent and disguised herself as a Girl Scout selling cookies. She let the kidnapper invite her into his apartment before killing him and throwing him from the window. After X-23 got Megan out of the building, Sarah sedated her and told her it was all a bad dream, before taking her back to her mother and claiming that she had found her wandering the streets. This had an unfortunate effect later in her life, as no one believed that Megan had really been kidnapped, including her therapist, who she was seeing for extreme post-traumatic stress. Megan began acting out during her teen years and seemingly had an obsession with her abduction, constantly drawing her attacker, as well as her savior. After Sarah's death, using the name Sarah had given her, Laura, formerly X-23, arrived at Debbie's house and stayed there with Debbie, Megan, and Debbie's boyfriend, Desmond. Laura told Megan that the incident when she was a child had been real, and she had been the one to apprehend her kidnapper. Megan demanded that she tell Debbie the same, although Laura refused, as she said it could alert the Facility to her location, and she explained her situation. Debbie arranged for Laura to go to school with Megan, although she had trouble fitting in and both she and Megan got suspended on her first day there. Rather than go home, the two stole the principal's car and had some fun, touring around several shops, watching a movie, and getting tickets to a concert. Unfortunately, Desmond was actually a Facility agent who attempted to use trigger scent to make Laura kill her aunt and cousin; however, he accidentally spilled it on himself, and was killed by X-23 soon after. Megan managed to rinse the trigger scent off of herself and Debbie, thus sparing their lives. Afterwards, Kimura and multiple Facility agents appeared in Debbie's house, and tried to kill them. Laura battled with Kimura, and after she won, she helped Debbie and Megan escape with new identities. Megan's new name was Elizabeth Victoria. ===Enemy of the State II=== Although it took her a great deal of effort, Kimura eventually managed to track Megan and her mother down. Though she considered killing them immediately, she instead chose not to reveal herself, and used them as leverage to force Laura into working for her during her gang war with Tyger Tiger. Megan and her mother were able to come out from hiding once again following Kimura's death at Laura's hands, allowing them to reunite with Laura as family, as well as meet Gabby, Laura's genetic clone and sister. ===Orphans of X=== After Laura found "Sarah" apparently alive in the Facility, she took her to Debbie and Megan's house, and Gabby met her there with Jonathan the Unstoppable. "Sarah" apologized to Laura, Debbie, and Megan for having lost so much time with them, and Megan became teary. Once Laura left the house to investigate gunfire, Gabby told Debbie and Megan to get down. Instead, Debbie picked up a frying pan and Megan picked up a knife, saying that they were willing to defend their home. When Daken entered with Laura, Megan was happy enough to welcome him despite his agitated demeanor; however, when Daken shot "Sarah" seemingly in cold blood, Megan attacked him with a frying pan, following Laura's lead. "Sarah" had actually been a clone made by the Orphans of X in order to extract information about the Muramasa Blade from Laura. Realizing this, all of them fled from the house and as they waited to catch a ride from Danger to Madripoor, Megan asked Laura about the Muramasa Blade. Megan said Laura shouldn't pay too much attention to the preachings of the Orphans of X, and that she had done a lot of good in the world; however, they were attacked by the Orphans of X and decided to change course to Tokyo, where they could get to Muramasa. Megan helped to bandage up Daken while he healed, and he apologized for his somewhat poor first impression. After Muramasa extracted parts of Laura, Gabby, and Daken's souls in order to make the Muramasa Armor, Megan helped look after them. Days later, when a rogue faction of the Hand came to take them, Megan and Debbie hid with Jonathan until Daken found them, carrying an injured Gabby. While Laura fought the Orphans using the Muramasa Armor, Daken asked Megan if he could borrow her phone. He warned her that was he was about to do was very disturbing, before slicing open his skin and embedding it underneath, so that he could get himself captured and allow Wolverine and Honey Badger to track him using Debbie's phone.
