michael baer.name: Michael Baer
michael baer.origin: ===Mutant Massacre=== Blockbuster was one of the Marauders involved in the massacre of the Morlocks. He helped Harpoon and Sabretooth ravage Angel's wings before encountering Thor. During a brief and vicious battle, Blockbuster succeeded in breaking Thor's right arm. However, Thor violently hurled his enchanted hammer Mjolnir at Blockbuster and killed him. A clone of Blockbuster was used by Mister Sinister when the Marauders confronted the X-Men near the Morlock tunnels again months later. However, he was corrupted by the influence of the Inferno and became demonic. While tracking Threnody and X-Man, he was killed by Arclight, lured into attacking him by Grey's illusions. He was seemingly cloned again and continued to serve Sinister until he was killed during their raid into Alaska in search of Hope Summers. Somehow, he came back to life again and rejoined the Marauders gathered by Da'o Cao Mạnh seemingly against his will as the others, and attacked the X-Men. He was eventually found fleeing out, terrified, but was killed by Warbird before Wolverine could stop her, as he wanted information. After being resurrected, the Marauders struck off on their own, once again massacring the Morlock population. This lead an angered Chamber, their new leader, to rejoin the X-Men. When the X-Men re-encountered the Morlocks, the Marauders fought briefly, but ultimately surrendered, professing their innocence. Not believing them, Chamber burned them to death with his psionic flame. Following the foundation of a mutant state in Krakoa by the hand of Charles Xavier and his allies, Blockbuster and the other Marauders remained in the clone farm where they had been reborn. They were enslaved and held captive by the Goblin Queen, who planned to use them as foot soldiers for an invasion of Krakoa. Blockbuster's former teammate Greycrow and his new team the Hellions destroyed the clone farm and killed Madelyne. Before leaving, Greycrow killed Blockbuster, freeing him to be resurrected by the Five.

michael burley.origin: Mike was a High School classmate of Richard Rider (AKA Nova) and his rival for the affections of Ginger Jaye. Mike played on the same basketball team as Rider and often bullied him. At one point, he was kidnapped by the Sandman, who had been hired to snatch Mike in order that his brother's criminal employers could exert pressure on him. One might dismiss Mike as a dumb jock but this is untrue. Mike Burley was the best student in his high school. Mike's father is an engineer and his older brother was a member of the Atomic Energy Commission. Mike's father and brother often pushed him to succeed.

michael collins.name: Michael Collins
michael collins.species: Human with his brain implanted into a Cyborg.
michael collins.origin: Michael Collins was a computer programmer working for Roxxon Oil. He thought that his programming for artificial limbs was going to be used to help handicapped people, not knowing that it was actually being used for the Deathlok Project. After he found out about his work being used for the creation of a killing machine, he complained to his friend and boss, Harlan Ryker, not knowing that Ryker was behind the Deathlok Project. Ryker betrayed Collins and had his brain placed into the Deathlok cyborg body. When Michael awoke, he found himself in the cyborg body, but unable to control it. The Deathlok cyborg was then tested, and Michael watched in horror, unable to do anything, as his cyborg body killed a couple of soldiers. Eventually, Michael gained control of the Deathlok cyborg and set out to find Harlan Ryker and make him pay for what he had done to Michael. Michael caught up with Ryker as he was making illegal weapons sales to a private army. Before Michael turned Ryker over to the authorities, he found out that his human body still existed, somewhere. Deathlok's search for his human body led him to encounter the Warwolf, which was programmed to destroy all evidence of Harlan Ryker's crimes, including eyewitnesses. Deathlok eventually stopped the Warwolf, killing it. ===The Souls of Cyber-Folk=== Deathlok was contacted by Misty Knight, as many cybernetic beings were being captured by an unknown enemy (later revealed to be Mechadoom). Mechadoom was attempting to figure out the secret of life by dissecting his captives, who included Ultron, Forge, Machine Man, Bushwhacker, Ruby Thursday and the remains of Jocasta. Initially appearing in the form of a Doombot, he was opposed by Deathlok and Misty, who escaped him and conferred with Reed Richards. Deathlok returned without back-up and was captured, but stalled Mechadoom until backup in the form of the Fantastic Four and members of the X-Men arrived. Deathlok talked Mechadoom into freeing the prisoners, and realized that Mechadoom had evolved a consciousness. Unfortunately, Ultron destroyed Mechadoom. Deathlok later crossed paths with The Punisher, and the two worked together to save Deathlok's son, Nick from drug dealers led by Silvermane. He next fought two old foes Ban Jacobs and Mainframe, who were seeking revenge for earlier defeats. Though they initially were able to override Michael's control of the Deathlok cyborg, he fought back and stopped them, though they escaped. Soon after, Michael Collins' soul was separated from the Deathlok cyborg by Nightmare, in order to use the cyborg to generate fear. The out of control body was opposed by Ghost Rider, who damaged the cyborg. Collins was able to regain control, and was repaired with the help of Nick Fury. He next worked with Curtis Carr against Moses Magnum to protect the former after he stole Cybertek data from the latter. ===The Biohazard Agenda=== After saving an ambassador from Powderkeg at the behest of S.H.I.E.L.D., Deathlok met with Nick Fury, who revealed that Tracy, Deathlok's wife, had figured out that he was inside the cyborg. Reuniting with them, their adjustment to the new family dynamic was cut short by Biohazard, a creature partly composed of cells from John Kelly, the original brain inside the Deathlok cyborg. Biohazard was defeated with the aid of a Mandroid armored S.H.I.E.L.D. agent named Earl Angstrom, who was avenging his son, Harry. Later Deathlok was brought into a future timeline by Timestream, who lied to him, and was defeated, though swore revenge. He was attacked by a Doppelganger during the Infinity War conflict, but managed to shut it down. ===Cyberwar=== Thinking about John Kelly, Collins accessed his memories, only to realize Kelly was now an artificial intelligence, who wanted control of the cybrog body back. Approached by Roxxon, Deathlok was offered a deal: head to France to stop production of Cyberwarriors and his body would be found in the same lab. He would be restored and the cyborg would go back to Roxxon (though Kelly would inhabit it, Roxxon being unaware of him). In France, Deathlok assaulted an Ultimatum facility for information about the Cyberwarriors, with the help of Silver Sable and her Wild Pack, though the Cyberwarriors , Ben Jacobs, and Mainframe quickly gained the upper hand. Thinking quickly, Deathlok attempted to override a Cyberwarrior, leading to Kelly taking it over and christening himself Siege. Siege, Deathlok and the Wild Pack continued fighting the Cyberwarriors until Mainframe and Jacobs made their escape, flooding the lab. During the firefight above Paris, Deathlok's hesitation to destroy a Cyberwarrior led to the death of two people. Jacobs, Mainframe and the remaining Cyberwarriors escaped, and Sable and her Pack left to intercept a Hydra purchased shipment of Cyberwarriors. While Deathlok and Siege argued, Nick Fury arrived to take over the operations against Cybertek. SHIELD takes down Siege, but he recovers and allows Deathlok to escape, us

michael columbus.name: Michael Columbus
michael columbus.origin: The young mutant known as Basilisk grew up with much persecution due to his abnormal appearance, and as such developed a very aggressive personality. Having lower than average intelligence, Basilisk was quick to anger, but his rage was just as easily quelled. After the X-Men went public, Basilisk became a student at the Xavier Institute. He was placed in Xorn's Special Class. On a camping trip with the Special Class, Basilisk was attacked by the U-Men, humans who hunted mutants for their organs. Basilisk saved the class from one of the U-Men, but only after Ernst told him that No-Girl would agree to date him. thumb|150px|left|Basilisk dead Shortly afterwards, Xorn "revealed" himself as Magneto, though he was in fact merely impersonating him. Basilisk joined his Brotherhood. Unfortunately, during Xorn's assault against New York City, he struck out at Basilisk, accidentally killing him.

michael crawley.name: Michael Crawley
michael crawley.origin: thumb|left|200px|Mike Crawley Michael 'Creepy' Crawley was an introverted orphan who had spent most of his life being pushed from one orphanage or foster home to another until the White Event gave him the paranormal ability to cause explosions, which he first manifested against his abusive foster father Mr. Lane, blowing up a bucket the man was holding. Michael fled, leaving Lane in shock, and found himself compelled to come from to San Francisco by what proved to be a psychic 'push' from the former CIA agent Emmett Proudhawk, who had gathered together a group of kids with paranormal abilities in order to protect them. When Proudhawk was killed, Michael and the rest of the kids whom he had code named Psi-Force found that they were able to collectively call into existence a psychic projection resembling him, called the Psi-Hawk. They also found that the link between them which created the Psi-Hawk would not let them leave each other, which to Mike was a blessing as the shy, lonely boy finally had something approaching a family. Months later, a sixth paranormal youth, Thomas Boyd joined the group and proved able to share in the link, however with six of them creating it the Psi-Hawk was dangerously unstable. Realizing that one would have to leave the group, Crawley took it upon himself to be that one, as he believed the others all needed each other. He fled, using an explosion to cover his tracks, and ended up at the Clinic for Paranormal Research, where he joined Dennis Cuzinski's gang, the DDTeens. When the DDTeens left the Clinic, Mike went with them, and later tried to get Cuzinski's friend Dave Landers to help him free Dennis from the clutches of a cult he had fallen in with. When Landers decided that Cuzinski should be allowed to make his own choices and stay with the cult, Mike regarded this as a betrayal and left for parts unknown.

michael ditillio.name: Michael Ditillio
michael ditillio.origin: Mickey Ditillio was an investigative reporter who worked with Senator Wilbur Wycombe to uncover stories on covert government activities. One such case was Project Glamor who were trying to continue the work of Theodore Sallis. After Wycombe disappeared, Mickey continued on his investigation. To this end he visited Sallis' lab in the Florida swamps but was captured by Jody Choate but escaped. He was recaptured by the satanic cult that was working with the project and was going to be its next test subject. Mickey narrowly survived the bombing of the shack and Ditillio learned the entire story of the Project from Lloyd Zahner and the cult's leader Demon. In a final attempt to silence Mickey, they kidnapped his girlfriend, Lyssa, but were saved by Railsback a former Project member who had been unwilling subjected to the serum. They fled, but were confronted by Choate who killed Zahner and Lyssa by smashing their heads together. Mickey was saved at the last minute by Man-Thing and Mikey returned to his office to release the story.

michael dorie.name: Michael Dorie
michael dorie.origin: Mike Dorie, a mutant telekinetic, was the only inhabitant of Picayune, Kansas, not to fall under the sway of the Harvester, a malevolent extraterrestrial who claimed to have created animal life on Earth. Mike's plight drew the attention of Nate Grey, the X-Man, who, as shaman to mutantkind, took up the duty of stopping the Harvester. Eventually, Nate realized that the only way to defeat the Harvester would be to sacrifice himself, and he anointed Mike his successor as shaman before he merged with the Harvester, scattering their energies to every animal cell on the planet and rendering Earth useless to the Harvester's people. Mike then left Kansas, seeking to fulfill his mission in life. His post-M-Day status is unknown, and S.H.I.E.L.D. had no information on his current whereabouts.

michael duffy.name: Michael Duffy
michael duffy.origin: Mike Duffy was a non-commissioned officer in the United States Army during World War II, holding the rank of Sergeant. He was in charge of Camp Lehigh in New Jersey and was known as a stern taskmaster. He was commonly found chewing out the junior enlisted men for "goldbricking" and was particularly fond of tormenting Private Steve Rogers and camp mascot James "Bucky" Barnes. Often times, other soldiers would play pranks on Duffy, who would instantly blame it on Rogers and Barnes. It is unspecified if Duffy was aware of Steve Roger's double identity of Captain America, as it was later revealed that many military officials were secretly aware of Cap's secret identity and were charged with helping to maintain it. ===1941=== Following the birth of Captain America, Steve Rogers was assigned to Camp Lehigh, where he was first introduced to Mike Duffy. Rogers' first assignment given to him by Sgt. Duffy was to guard General Ellsworth. However, Rogers reported for duty too late to stop Ellsworth to be eliminated by a Nazi spy. Steve would later catch this spy as Captain America. This job bungle set the record for Duffy, and likely fueled his future dislike of Rogers. Shortly after, Duffy assigned Steve to K.P. duty to peel potatoes, and gave the private grief for flirting with FBI agent Betty Ross. When Duffy checked back later to see that Steve was not done peeling potatoes, unaware that Steve was out fighting the Oriental Giants as Captain America. Duffy would soon become a competitor for Miss Ross' affections. Shortly after this, Duffy assigned Steve Rogers to stable duty for abandoning his post to secretly battle the Wax Man as Captain America. When the soldiers at Camp Lehigh were hired to play the role of extras in a film titled the "Tyrant", Duffy was served a great indignity when he was casted as the court jester. Following Captain America's battle with the Hunchback, Duffy berated Steve Rogers after overhearing him calling Captain America "overrated". Duffy was quick to blame and punish Steve Rogers for a number of infractions at this time: Giving Steve onion peeling duty for supposedly putting sneezing powder in his pipe and then later abandoning post during drills; K.P. duty for putting frogs in his bed and then leaving camp after taps. Later, when Sgt. Duffy led his troops in trying to find an escaped German prisoner of war named Wolfgang, he had Steve Rogers and Bucky Barnes removed from the battle by medics unaware that they were responsible for stopping Wolfgang from making off with a new experimental "Vanishing Ray" as Captain America and Bucky. Once more Duffy punished the two soldiers when in New York City they abandoned their post to battle Zombies as Captain America and Bucky. For those, Duffy assigned them to boot blacking duty. Duffy assigned Steve Rogers K.P. duty for various infractions, while fighting Axis threats such as the original Circus of Crime and the Dragon of Death in Hawaii. Duffy also assigned Steve to protect a Chinese diplomat in San Francisco who was later captured and rescued from the Fang by Captain America. Later that year when Camp Lehigh was putting on a play to boost soldier morale, Duffy was in charge of its organization. The play was briefly interrupted by an attack by the Red Skull. Around this time the troupe was invited to witness a violin performance. Duffy would warn Rogers and Barnes. Yet, at the performance the hypocrite ended up falling asleep and began snoring loudly. Following Captain America and Bucky's clash with the Nazi spy known as the Fiddler, Duffy informed Steve and James that they won a draw for a pair of violins. When the two fainted in front of him, Duffy could not understand why. Beginning to win Betty Ross with his apparent charm, Duffy had a lunch meeting with her in which he was struck in the face with a pie by one of his men. Duffy believed that Steve Rogers was responsible and was led away by Betty to be cleaned up. He vowed to Rogers that he would give him K.P. duty for a month in response to his pieing. Later, when an itching powder prank in the troop barracks created too much racket, Duffy storms in to find out what's going on. He became the butt of another prank: A bucket of water placed above the door and was doused with water. Duffy blames Steve Rogers when he arrives shortly after and sends him to the guard house. On another morning, Duffy came to berate Steve and James for sleeping in late, unaware that they were out late the night before battling the Black Witch as Captain America and Bucky the night before. Steve Rogers was not the only soldier that Duffy gave a hard time to however, soon Duffy was giving flack to Private Bobby "Shrimpie" Shaw who was nearly a physically ill prepared for the military as Steve Rogers was before Operation Rebirth. As 1941 came to an end, Duffy was still just as critical as ever with Steve Rogers. Sending him to the guard house for being AWOL while he was out fighting criminal Nick Pinto as Captain Ame

fields.notes: Mike Duffy's tombstone as depicted in is cut off by the panel margin, but the numbers of his birth date are only partially obscured. He appears to have been born on a 17th in either 1910, 1918 or 1919. While the Golden Age often portrayed Steve Rogers as acting independently in his costumed identity, it has since been retconned that many military officials were secretly aware of his double identity and were charged with helping to maintain it. It has not been specified, however, if Duffy was aware of Steve Rogers' secret double identity; it can be safely presumed that he was genuinely unaware if his Golden Age appearances can be taken at face value and not fictionalized retellings of actual events within continuity.

michael dunwoody.name: Michael Dunwoody
michael dunwoody.first_appearance: King in Black: Iron Man/Doom Vol 1 1
michael dunwoody.origin: Mike Dunwoody was a businessman located in Paramus, New Jersey, and the owner of Snow Globe Holiday Decoration Supply. During Knull's invasion of Earth, Mike was corrupted by one of Knull's symbiotes. thumb|left|Under Knull's influence While dressed as Santa Claus, Mike rode a flying sleigh pulled by corrupted reindeer. When he approached Manhattan, he was spotted by Iron Man and Doctor Doom, who became confused as to whether Mike was the real Santa Claus or not. Iron Man and Doom engaged Dunwoody, and he attacked them both while signing deranged versions of Christmas carols. After Doom killed the reindeer, Iron Man used the new powers of his symbiote-infused armor to take over Mike's sleigh and flip it over, plunging him into the streets below. Mike survived the fall and attempted to attack Iron Man with symbiote tendrils. Stark retaliated with a repulsor blast which caused a massive explosion when the two attacks met. Due to the modifications of Iron Man's armor, the blast cleansed Knull's corruption off Mike. While still in-character, Mike acknowledged both Tony and Victor and walked away. He accidentally left behind his driver's license, which Iron Man picked up and allowed him to learn "Santa"'s true identity.

After Doom killed the reindeer, Iron Man used the new powers of his symbiote-infused armor to take over Mike's sleigh and flip it over, plunging him into the streets below. Mike survived the fall and attempted to attack Iron Man with symbiote tendrils. Stark retaliated with a repulsor blast which caused a massive explosion when the two attacks met. Due to the modifications of Iron Man's armor, the blast cleansed Knull's corruption off Mike. While still in-character, Mike acknowledged both Tony and Victor and walked away. He accidentally left behind his driver's license, which Iron Man picked up and allowed him to learn "Santa"'s true identity.

michael english.name: Michael English
michael english.origin: Atom Smasher and his minions broke into a factory in San Francisco to steal electronics when he is confronted by Spider-Woman, whom he easily defeated. He then traveled to Los Angeles to steal components from a Stark-West facility, defeating The Thing at the same time. Spider-Woman and The Thing teamed up with Giant-Man to attack Atom Smasher's deserted power company where he was building a doomsday weapon called the Neutralode. During the fight Atom Smasher admitted that he was not the original Atom Smasher, but his brother, Michael. As the fights turned against him, Atom Smasher attempted to enhance his powers by activating the Neutralode, but since it was damaged in the fight it instead exploded and seemingly killed him. He later appeared causing a rampage in New York, but was stopped by Captain America and Toro.

michael faraday.name: Michael Faraday
michael faraday.origin: Michael Faraday was an British scientist who contributed to the study of electromagnetism and electrochemistry. His inventions of electromagnetic rotary devices formed the foundation of electric motor technology, and it was largely due to his efforts that electricity became practical for use in technology. Doctor Saturn claimed that his theories were used and applied by British scientist Faraday, however these claims cannot be substantiated.

He was introduced to Steve by Joshua Cooper and the two quickly became friends, with Mike even introducing Steve to Bernie Rosenthal. When a real estate developer hired the villain Blockbuster to torch the building in front of their aparments Mike and his team intervened but his collegue Sam died in the fire. He later helped Captain America capture Blockbuster but when he learned that he was Sam's killer he got furious and needed to be restrained by the police.

michael fleet.name: Michael Fleet
michael fleet.origin: Michael's brother Jonas, another cryptozoologist, sent another team some time later to find the creature, under the guise that they were searching for the legendary sasquatch. This group was massacred by the Wendigo. Jonas, his wife Tamara who had once been engaged to Michael, and Heather Hudson arrived with local authorities to clean up the crime scene. Wolverine, who had been in the area, dropped in to see what was going on, and realized from stool left behind that this wasn't a sasquatch, but a wendigo. As he left to track the creature, Jonas followed. The two arrived near a cave just as the Hulk, seeking isolation, landed nearby. This caused the Wendigo to emerge and attack the green behemoth. Wolverine joined in the fight, and Jonas used technology borrowed from S.H.I.E.L.D. to capture the Wendigo. As he, Tamara, whom he still had not told his suspicions that the Wendigo was her ex-fiancé, and a drugged Wendigo flew over New York City, Tamara attempted to kill the beast she believed murdered her former lover. However, the beast managed to growl out her name, startling her. The Wendigo then broke free of his restraints and the ship itself, falling into New York. The Wendigo confronted a young woman who tried to use mace on it, angering the monster. Before it could attack her, she was saved by Spider-Man and Ghost Rider, who had arrived searching for the local killer. While the three fought, Jonas and Tamara arrived, wounding the creature, sending it fleeing back into the woods. Jonas briefed Spider-Man on the situation, leaving out his knowledge that the Wendigo was his brother. They tracked the monster to the Central Park Zoo, where it had killed several people there as well. The Wendigo grabbed Tamara, almost gently, trying to communicate with her. Ghost Rider arrived to deal his brand of justice to the monster, but Spider-Man, realizing this was not the way, stopped the Spirit of Vengeance. Ghost Rider instead used his penance stare on the creature, and found the truth about the fate of Michael Fleet. The now-docile beast was taken into custody, with Tamara by his side.

michael galvan.name: Michael Galvan
michael galvan.origin: Galvan was running to be president on the ticket of the Liberty Party. While attending a rally in Los Angeles, he was attacked by Deathweb. The timely intervention of the Avengers saved his life. However, a traitor in Galvan's party, Wilson Lambert, was working behind the scenes to ensure Galvan's death. Lambert knew that if Galvan died, he would replace him on the ticket. Thanks to Lambert's scheming, Deathweb's second attempt was successful.

michael goodwin.name: Michael Goodwin
michael goodwin.origin: Michael Goodwin is the younger brother of Stevie Goodwin. Stevie served in the Vietnam War under the command of Frank Castle and died during the Firebase Valley Forge Massacre. Stevie's death, Castle's survival of the Massacre and later transformation into The Punisher, and Michael Goodwin's meeting with Letrong Giap at a Smithsonian conference led to Michael writing a book about the Firebase Valley Forge Massacre called Valley Forge, Valley Forge. After the publication of Valley Forge, Michael interviewed Giap to get his side of the story about the Vietnam War, and that in turn prompted an interview with the remaining men of Castle's first command. Michael Goodwin believed the Vietnam War was what changed Frank Castle into the Punisher, ironically proving Punisher correct decades ago when Castle believed people will blame his actions on Vietnam, and be right and wrong about that.

michael hall.name: Michael Hall
michael hall.origin: Michael Hall was seen at the New York Medical Expo previewing technology that allowed prosthetics to read the mind of their wearers, and act according to the wearer's thoughts by reacting to emotions. Hall also saved Cletus Kasady and the Carnage Symbiote from dying in space, and kept Kasady contained on Earth. He created new suits of armor that incorporated the symbiote into their design which allowed the Carnage Symbiote to overtake their armors and kill their wearers. It was discovered that the symbiote was used in the production of the prosthetics. After Carnage and Shriek were stopped, Hall went into hiding but was hunted down and tortured - presumably to death - by Kasady.

michael hart.name: Michael Hart
michael hart.origin: Originally a defence attorney for supervillains who had a high acquittal rate, Michael Hart become a judge who was dedicated to imprisoning villains after meeting his wife Alice Dickinson on a case. His wife was accidentally killed by The Tinkerer who broke into Hart's home in order to get revenge for the death of his son, The Agent. Hart returned home before the Tinkerer could escape, and the latter struck down Hart. With the help of the Harts' doorman, the Tinkerer took Hart back to his place to attempt to revive him. He succeeded, but through unknown reasons he was transformed into a spirit being without any knowledge of what the Tinkerer had done to him or his wife. It is possible that the amulet he wore, gifted to him by his wife, may have been the cause of this transformation. His supernatural form was constantly drawn into Zeitgeist, a realm that was inhabited by the ghosts of those who would not move on, where he was forced to witness countless murders. This lead to Hart calling himself "Judge", and returning to the normal world to become a vigilante, passing sentences in the form of spirits that inhabited his body called "The Jury". After several criminal murders, the reporter Katherine Farrell began to investigate Judge and The Tinkerer. After rescuing her multiple times, Judge took her into the Zeitgeist in order to allow her to understand his purpose better. After researching she eventually realized the truth and confronted both men, and in his anger, Judge unleashed the Jury on the Tinkerer. However, they spared him and Judge and Tinkerer reached a mutual understanding that they were both atoning for past sins.

michael heron.name: Michael Heron
michael heron.origin: Michael Herron had been a Catholic priest but he left, being unable to avoid questioning his own faith. He became a surgeon in the armed services, and though pressured to return to the Church, found himself happier and more faithful in his new position. He discovered Satana left for dead in an alleyway. While he was assisting her, her attackers (minions of the N'Garai) returned but were slain by Exiter. Heron brought Satana back to his apartment to treat her injuries, but more minions arrived and abducted Heron but was rescued by Satana. Satana gave Heron the ring Azshiran to defend him from demon's born of "Satan". Satan sent Agathon the Tempter to capture Heron and with Satan's help was able slice off Heron's hand, separating him from the ring. Heron was then delivered to Satan and was later joined by a captured Satana. During Satana's fight with Demons, Heron broke free and joined in the fight but was mortally wounded by a spear. Satan commanded her to take Heron's soul but she refused and allowed him to die in peace. Due to this action, Satana was exiled from Satan's realm.

michael jacobs.name: Michael Jacobs
michael jacobs.origin: Mike "The Mic" Jacobs was a radio host for Shock Roxx Radio, a radio station owned by the Roxxon Corporation. After Bruce Banner publicized the existence of the government-funded Shadow Base, "The Mic" berated the government on his show for using taxpayer money to fight the Hulk, instead suggesting the private sector should step in for that. After Roxxon declared bankruptcy due to the fallout of their CEO Dario Agger's attempt to destroy the Hulk using Xemnu, "The Mic" moved to Fact Channel Radio.

michael janes.name: Michael Janes
michael janes.origin: Father Michael Janes was once a soldier during the Siancong War. Janes and many in his combat unit (including William Talltrees) were guilty of several war crimes including slaughtering a village of defenseless people. The lone survivor was a boy named Duc No Tranh who grew up to become the assassin the Bengal. Duc No Tranh had attempted to climb aboard the chopper that was evacuating Janes' unit (piloted by James Rhodes) but Janes and Fong kicked Duc No Tranh out of the chopper. As an adult Duc No Tranh aka the Bengal began killing other members of Janes' unit such as Samus Birulin and later made attempts on Willie Lincoln and William Talltrees. The attempt to kill Willie Lincoln was stopped by Daredevil. Janes received a court-martial and served 14 years of a 25 year sentence in Quantico where he found God. He later became a catholic priest. It was in this role that he befriended Silhouette Chord. Eventually the Bengal came to kill Janes but was stopped by Night Thrasher who thought Bengal was after Silhouette. Matters became more complicated when the Punisher came to kill Silhouette because he suspected she was funding her brother's street gang the Concrete Dragons which she denied (years later Night Thrasher discovered she was in fact funding them after all). Thanks to the Punisher's intervention style the Bengal makes peace with Night Thrasher and Father Janes. Father Janes spent months trying to help the Bengal reconcile their past but the Bengal left his care and went to kill Gai No Don who was an infamous Siancong general who had killed many people. thumb|200px|right Father Janes is later asked by Night Thrasher to become a board member of the Taylor Foundation, a charity Night Thrasher's father (also a Siancong vet) founded. Interestingly Gai No Don is also asked to join so Night Thrasher could make use of his deviousness. Father Janes on behalf of the Taylor Foundation and the New Warrior member named Justice both worked closely with the child advocacy group Childwatch whose mission statement was to protect children from abuse.

michael jeffries.name: Michael Jeffries
michael jeffries.origin: Michael Jeffries, in need of a Halloween costume for a party he was attending, began digging around in his parents attic. Michael discovered the Torpedo costume in a chest that had been inherited by Mike's father Phillip after Brock Jones's death (Brock and Phillip were first cousins). Initially, he shared it with his friend, Mickey Musashi, but she used the armor more than him, and eventually became the one and only Turbo. Mike, however, did get two opportunities to use the armor . Mike donned the armor and fought (somewhat admirably, for a rookie hero) alongside some of New York's greatest heroes, including the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and Spider-Man. Directly after the mission, Nova offered to train the two Turbos, and just by happenstance, Cardinal and his Air Force chose to attack them just as Mike had donned the armor . He was basically ineffective in the battle, and it fell to Mickey to devise a way to take out the villains with an electric shock. After these two opportunities, the next time a Turbo was needed, it was a dire emergency and he had to give in to the more experienced Turbo, Mickey. He would never don the armor again. Mickey soon became a member of the team, and although she actually contemplated retiring from the biz and asking the team to help Mike take over her role, circumstances soon changed. It turned out that the armor had originally been commissioned by Volx, the Dire Wraith Queen, as a comparable armor to Rom's. Volx had been using the US government, but thankfully Brock Jones discovered the ruse, and took the armor for himself. He would fight with ROM against her a few times, but eventually retired from his heroic lifestyle. The armor was put into storage (where Mike found it) and forgotten about by most of Earth. However, Volx had not forgotten, and eventually made her way back to Earth, stowing away on Garthan Saal's spaceship. Eventually, she hunted down Mike, killed him, and then transformed her appearance to his. She then went to the Warriors, and asked to "don the armor one last time" before Brock Jones' son Daniel took it back (a scenario she had invented). They gave their "friend" the armor , and it took the efforts of Saal, the new Nova, the entire Warriors team, and their new member Timeslip, to prevent her from removing the powers of every super-powered individual on the planet.

michael kramer.name: Michael Kramer
michael kramer.origin: ===World War II=== African American Michael Kramer was a member of the United States Army Air Force (later USAF), and the pilot of an all-black American air force fighter squadron in the summer of 1944 during World War II. Kramer was shot down over Germany and captured, but instead of being assigned to a prisoner-of-war camp, Adolf Hitler personally ordered that Kramer and 70 other men, also African American pilots, be handed over to the Red Skull for a secret project. The Skull led Kramer and the others to a biochemical warfare laboratory to develop biological secret weapons. This inhumane activity constituted a war crime. Kramer's genetic matrix was modified to make him a carrier of, though immune to, a plague comparable to the Black Death, with a projected mortality rate of 99%. Although some African-American pilots survived, most other test subjects died agonizingly, with Kramer being the project's first success, codenamed Judas Man; the disease itself was called the Judas Plague. However, the deadly virus on Kramar needed a catalyst to activate it, which was not within Kramer himself. Between October and December 1944, Nick Fury's Howling Commandos, Captain America and Bucky freed Kramer and other African-American pilots being held, in the process destroying the laboratory before the Nazis could repeat the success. Still, that project went on to be studied by the criminal organization Hydra as the deadliest virus in history, encouraging searches for comparable doomsday weapons. Kramer was mistakenly presumed dead, but in reality he chose to go into hiding. Kramer, knowing the details of what had been done to him, believed that the virus's catalyst had been destroyed with the laboratory, and that therefore the virus was not dangerous and he could lead a normal life. However, he feared that the authorities would investigate him and decide that, as a precaution, it was best to keep him locked up or to execute him. Kramer had a daughter, Pamela ("Pam"), whose body naturally developed the antidote to the plague. Over the next few decades, Kramer's genes continued to mutate until they completely nullified the virus, though he was unaware of it. As a side effect of these mutations, Kramer aged much more slowly than a normal person. ===Recent Times=== In recent times, the nihilistic villainess Viper, linked to Hydra and who had most recently worked with the mutant mercenary Silver Samurai, learned that Kramer was still alive , and developed a plan to capture Kramer and release the Judas Man plague on America. Viper, knowing that Pam Kramer had the antidote, intended to capture Pam as well, and sought to capture Michael before Nick Fury or Captain America found out about him. Being cautious, Viper did not even share her plan with Silver Samurai initially, although Silver Samurai was Viper's chief operative throughout the effort; she also had several trained hitmen and secret bases. Viper's forces grew ever closer to Kramer. Worried, Kramer realized he was drawing dangerous attention to himself that put Pam, then a college student, in danger. On the run, Kramer escaped from his own family and hid out in a flea-bag hotel in San Francisco; Kramer believed he had provided for Pam and that he could have a life away since he had not committed any crimes, so he bought a ticket to escape on a freighter. However, wanting to find him, Pam enlisted the help of the police; when they did not take her seriously, Pam attempted to hire a private investigator, Jessica Drew (secretly the superheroine Spider-Woman). Viper, wanting to remain secret, sent three agents (Deke, Freddie and Gino) to kidnap Pam on the spot; but Pam resisted and, with Spider-Woman's help, escaped. Viper killed Deke and Freddie lest they may frame her, but Gino was arrested, and Spider-Woman was able to see Viper escape. Drew took the case and sent Pam to Drew's house to protect her. The Samurai discovered where Pam was hiding and informed Viper when she briefed him on her plans. By this time, sorceress Morgan Le Fay had been manipulating Viper into believing that she, Viper, was Jessica Drew's long-lost mother, but despite her emotional dismay, Viper went ahead with the plan and attempted to capture Pam while sending Silver Samurai after Kramer; the plan was that the Samurai tailed Drew so that Drew would find Kramer for them. Drew bribed a bartender to tip him off to the hotel where Kramer was staying, and later paid off the hotel clerk as well. He found Kramer in a room on the sixth floor, but Kramer, fearing he was being followed, had made sure to have a rooftop escape route out the window and a gun. When Drew knocked on his door, Kramer shot her through the wood and fled out the window, but Drew gave chase. Drew explained to Kramer that he knew Viper was after him, and appealed to his fatherly protective instincts by telling him that Viper was threatening Pam as well, encouraging him to fight back. During the chase, the Samurai revealed himself, urgi

fields.history: ===World War II=== African American Michael Kramer was a member of the United States Army Air Force (later USAF), and the pilot of an all-black American air force fighter squadron in the summer of 1944 during World War II. Kramer was shot down over Germany and captured, but instead of being assigned to a prisoner-of-war camp, Adolf Hitler personally ordered that Kramer and 70 other men, also African American pilots, be handed over to the Red Skull for a secret project. The Skull led Kramer and the others to a biochemical warfare laboratory to develop biological secret weapons. This inhumane activity constituted a war crime. Kramer's genetic matrix was modified to make him a carrier of, though immune to, a plague comparable to the Black Death, with a projected mortality rate of 99%. Although some African-American pilots survived, most other test subjects died agonizingly, with Kramer being the project's first success, codenamed Judas Man; the disease itself was called the Judas Plague. However, the deadly virus on Kramar needed a catalyst to activate it, which was not within Kramer himself. Between October and December 1944, Nick Fury's Howling Commandos, Captain America and Bucky freed Kramer and other African-American pilots being held, in the process destroying the laboratory before the Nazis could repeat the success. Still, that project went on to be studied by the criminal organization Hydra as the deadliest virus in history, encouraging searches for comparable doomsday weapons. Kramer was mistakenly presumed dead, but in reality he chose to go into hiding. Kramer, knowing the details of what had been done to him, believed that the virus's catalyst had been destroyed with the laboratory, and that therefore the virus was not dangerous and he could lead a normal life. However, he feared that the authorities would investigate him and decide that, as a precaution, it was best to keep him locked up or to execute him. Kramer had a daughter, Pamela ("Pam"), whose body naturally developed the antidote to the plague. Over the next few decades, Kramer's genes continued to mutate until they completely nullified the virus, though he was unaware of it. As a side effect of these mutations, Kramer aged much more slowly than a normal person. ===Recent Times=== In recent times, the nihilistic villainess Viper, linked to Hydra and who had most recently worked with the mutant mercenary Silver Samurai, learned that Kramer was still alive , and developed a plan to capture Kramer and release the Judas Man plague on America. Viper, knowing that Pam Kramer had the antidote, intended to capture Pam as well, and sought to capture Michael before Nick Fury or Captain America found out about him. Being cautious, Viper did not even share her plan with Silver Samurai initially, although Silver Samurai was Viper's chief operative throughout the effort; she also had several trained hitmen and secret bases. Viper's forces grew ever closer to Kramer. Worried, Kramer realized he was drawing dangerous attention to himself that put Pam, then a college student, in danger. On the run, Kramer escaped from his own family and hid out in a flea-bag hotel in San Francisco; Kramer believed he had provided for Pam and that he could have a life away since he had not committed any crimes, so he bought a ticket to escape on a freighter. However, wanting to find him, Pam enlisted the help of the police; when they did not take her seriously, Pam attempted to hire a private investigator, Jessica Drew (secretly the superheroine Spider-Woman). Viper, wanting to remain secret, sent three agents (Deke, Freddie and Gino) to kidnap Pam on the spot; but Pam resisted and, with Spider-Woman's help, escaped. Viper killed Deke and Freddie lest they may frame her, but Gino was arrested, and Spider-Woman was able to see Viper escape. Drew took the case and sent Pam to Drew's house to protect her. The Samurai discovered where Pam was hiding and informed Viper when she briefed him on her plans. By this time, sorceress Morgan Le Fay had been manipulating Viper into believing that she, Viper, was Jessica Drew's long-lost mother, but despite her emotional dismay, Viper went ahead with the plan and attempted to capture Pam while sending Silver Samurai after Kramer; the plan was that the Samurai tailed Drew so that Drew would find Kramer for them. Drew bribed a bartender to tip him off to the hotel where Kramer was staying, and later paid off the hotel clerk as well. He found Kramer in a room on the sixth floor, but Kramer, fearing he was being followed, had made sure to have a rooftop escape route out the window and a gun. When Drew knocked on his door, Kramer shot her through the wood and fled out the window, but Drew gave chase. Drew explained to Kramer that he knew Viper was after him, and appealed to his fatherly protective instincts by telling him that Viper was threatening Pam as well, encouraging him to fight back. fields.notes: Michael Kramer was genetically modified during World War II to become superhumanly long-lived; the comic saga he first appeared in, to , were published between 1981 and 1982, so at time of publication he could have been a veteran who had been in the War in his 20s, and who was in his 60s at the time. Precisely because one of the effects of his powers was a longer time span, him serving in World War II is not necessarily topical - especially as it was confirmed by mostly-recent handbooks like (2005), (2007), (2007), (2008), and (2008). His daughter Pamela had told Jessica Drew that Michael was a man in his 60s, which can either be a topical reference, or a misunderstanding if Michael had hid his real origin from his daughter to protect her. While the Judas Man is first mentioned in , the previous issue ( ) has a preview of that story arc in the last page, showing a white man (possible supposed to be Michael with wrong coloring) being chased by an armed person. There are a number of inaccuracies related to the Judas Man: explicitly said that Kramer had not been taken to a "stalag" (prisoner-of-war camp), but to a secret laboratory so he'd "disappear"; it also specifies that Captain America and Nick Fury's commandos released Kramer and destroyed the laboratory, apparently in the same operation which suggests that Kramer was being held in the laboratory itself. Captain America's profile in and (listed as "Captain America (Rogers)" in the latter) both say that Captain America and others released Kramer from a concentration camp in late 1944. Nick Fury's profile in and say Kramer was released from one of the Red Skull's biochemical warfare camps. It is thus unclear what kind of camp was Kramer in when he was released. (Viper's profile) and (Silver Samurai's profile) both say that these villains "attempted to kidnap Michael Kramer" in Spider-Woman #42 and #42-43 respectively. However, at the end of , the Samurai succeeds in kidnapping Kramer, as confirmed in . In , when Kramer mentions how he'd leave by freighter, he misspells the word as "frieghter".

michael logue.name: Michael Logue
michael logue.origin: Michael Logue was an employee of the Butler. He was one of the agents that would regularly attack Deadpool and harvest some of his organs. Many years later, Deadpool found Michael's fingerprints in one of the Butler's front companies, and tracked him down to a stripper club where he worked. Michael was confronted and interrogated by Deadpool, but he panicked and suffered of a heart attack. Deadpool saved Michael with mouth-to-mouth resuscitation and remained with him as an ambulance transported him to a hospital. He demanded for Michael to write down a journal detailing every single moment he worked with the Butler. Days later, Deadpool visited Logue, who had returned to his job and written everything he could remember in a notebook. Deadpool grabbed it and burned it, to Michael's dismay, having decided to let go of his past.

michael lynch.name: Michael Lynch
michael lynch.origin: Lt. Michael Lynch's life changed the evening he came to the rescue of female daredevil Sharon Ventura when she was being attacked by a gang of thugs while on her way to undergo strength enhancement from the Power Broker. After helping her he went about his evening warning her to keep out of trouble. Lynch find his own trouble when the gang attacked him later in the night for revenge. He was saved by Sharon's friend the Thing who was seeking to stop her from undergoing the Power Broker's process. He was too late, as Sharon was exposed to the treatment by the Broker's chief scientist Dr. Karl Malus. But before Malus could get her addicted to the drugs that the Broker used to keep his other customers under his control, Sharon broke free. Escaping the Power Broker's facility she was attacked by drug addicted members of the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. The Thing bought Sharon and Michael time to escape. They went back to the hotel where Sharon tried to warn Auntie Freeze, the manager of the Grapplers, a female wrestling team that Ventura was trying to join. Thinking that Sharon underwent the full process and was now addicted to drugs, Freeze gave her a new costume to wear. Upon seeing Sharon in costume, Lynch mentioned how it reminded him of the original Ms. Marvel, giving Sharon her costumed name. The pair were growing attracted to each other and were about to kiss when Auntie Freeze and the Grapplers tried to attack them. They were rescued by the Thing, who helped them escape. Lynch accompanied the Thing and Ms. Marvel when they tried to go back to the Power Broker's hideout only to find that the villain had closed up shop and disappeared. The trio were then attacked by UCWF wrestlers but the fight quickly ended when the Thing's mutation began to become unstable. Ms. Marvel then rushed the Thing to the hospital for treatment.

michael lynn.name: Michael Lynn
michael lynn.origin: The Lynn family, with Michael driving, was involved in a car accident where two passers-by and his son were killed, while his wife Adrian was paralyzed. Later, Adrian recovered the use of her legs by submitting herself to an experimental medical program and moreover she gained superhuman strength. Using the name Adrenazon, Adrian tried to take revenge on She-Hulk, because after the incident Jennifer Walters managed to get Michael condemned on the count of manslaughter and ended up in jail where he could no longer bear the remorse and committed suicide.

michael malone.name: Michael Malone
michael malone.origin: The commanding officer at Christmastown, an American radar station positioned in the Canadian Arctic, Colonel Michael Malone was present when Patricia Robertson arrived from visiting the Ararat Corporation research facility, informing him that all the researchers present had been killed except one, Perry. Unbeknownst to any of them, the facility had created a ravenous clone of the Venom symbiote, which had bonded to Ivan, one of the base's sled dogs. The symbiote detached from Ivan and bonded to Malone, taking over him and hunting the other soldiers in the Christmastown while impersonating him in order to avoid suspicion. The symbiote quickly drained Malone's vitality and killed him, but used his body as a puppet until it was attacked by the Suit. It discarded Malone's corpse and used it as a decoy to distract the Suit. thumb|Without the symbiote

michael marchand.name: Michael Marchand
michael marchand.origin: ===Origin=== Sometime after Jessica Drew entered her cryo-sleep, Michael was born to Miriam Drew, who realized she was alone and had Michael be raised by her cousin in America as their own child. He grew up well educated and inherited ownership over his foster parent's pharmaceutical company, Marchand Pharmaceuticals. 180px|thumb|left|Young Michael In college, he fell in love with Alison Jones and together would have a daughter, Rebecca. However, when Alison developed radiation sickness during her pregnancy, Michael learned from his resurfaced mother that it was a side effect of Michael's altered genetic makeup, and he blamed himself for Alison' death and Rebecca's genetic disease. Michael used the company to treat his daughter Rebecca's rare condition to no avail, until he used Jonathan Drew's radiation research to craft a cure. Despite positive results, the remission only lasted a year before her condition worsened, and he realized too late that the research was incomplete. He sought out Jessica Drew in the hopes that she would be the key to curing Rebecca, as she was proof of the research. But not wanting to risk confrontation, Michael used the excuse of needing security for Rebecca's birthday party to contact Spider-Woman, and covertly subjected her the experimental medication which removed her radiological immunity. ===Family Drama=== Hiring Big Ronnie to give Jess a special materials new suit to monitor her vitals, Jess attended the birthday, worrying Michael with her uncharacteristic behavior against Rebecca's would-be kidnappers. After Jess realized the subterfuge, she confronted him as he admitted with full explanation and he also stated that not finding a cure could potentially pass to her son, Gerry. With Jessica's participation, Michael's treatments sped her recovery and they pursued the next piece of the research with the thought extinct Latrodectus Aeternum spider. While Jess was outraged Michael didn't warn her about Octavia Vermis, he defended his position with the need for finding a cure for his daughter being a priority. After mentioning how her son is, the building was besieged and Michael's doctor Stephen took Rebecca hostage for the Aeternum spider. Once Rebecca was safe, he directed Jess to his private jet, which he and Jess piloted to a new destination. Once safe, Jess found Wundagore Mountain and was greeted with their mother, Miriam Drew. After Miriam appraised Jess of how things came to be, their location was compromised by an attack from Octavia and her L.M.D. army., during which Miriam turned on Jess and revealed herself as a clone. The Drew women brawled across the base until Michael used the Spider formula to boost Jess' strength. The fight was interrupted as Octavia took Rebecca, forcing Miriam to sacrifice herself as Michael escaped with Rebecca by Jess' escort. Safe outside, Michael admitted to having known Miriam was already a clone, being desperate for any route to cure Rebecca. He parted ways with Jess on strained terms, but both promised to find a cure for their condition. ===A Very Bad Choice=== After Jess handed Michael a copy of the cure array file, he tested it on his secretary (and lover), Rose Roché, granting her spider powers similar to Jess. But the medical information was promptly corrupted by a failsafe on their floppy disk that destroyed all data. To recover the data, Rose hired mercenaries to recover the original file, but Jess found out and confronted Michael to learn the truth. Jess returned afterwards as Spider-Woman to destroy the machine, but Michael used the array on himself with his serum as a catalyst. Developing his own set of spider powers, Michael became vehemently aggressive towards Jess, overpowering her and blaming his woes in life on her. Despite Rebecca's arrival pleading mercy, he ignored her and renamed himself Aeturnum. Rose then mind-controlled Jess with her pheromone powers to take Rebecca and fly a helicopter rigged to explode. The two women managed to escape, but ran into Rose and Michael again at his apartment. Still blinded by the effects of the serum, an augmented Michael fought Jessica while Rose handled Rebecca, but the heroic ladies were victorious as Jess knocked Michael unconscious and Rebecca injected Rose with a serum that removed her powers. As the villainous duo was escorted away by company security, Rebecca told Michael that she'd leave him some money on his bank account to get as far away from her as possible. His parting words were tearfully apologetic, realizing she was perfect just the way she was. ===New Life of Villainy=== Following his and Rose's exile, they were approached by Octavia Vermis and joined the Anti-Arach9, a supervillain team squarely focused on eliminating Spider-Woman.

Despite positive results, the remission only lasted a year before her condition worsened, and he realized too late that the research was incomplete. He sought out Jessica Drew in the hopes that she would be the key to curing Rebecca, as she was proof of the research. But not wanting to risk confrontation, Michael used the excuse of needing security for Rebecca's birthday party to contact Spider-Woman, and covertly subjected her the experimental medication which removed her radiological immunity. ===Family Drama=== Hiring Big Ronnie to give Jess a special materials new suit to monitor her vitals, Jess attended the birthday, worrying Michael with her uncharacteristic behavior against Rebecca's would-be kidnappers. After Jess realized the subterfuge, she confronted him as he admitted with full explanation and he also stated that not finding a cure could potentially pass to her son, Gerry. With Jessica's participation, Michael's treatments sped her recovery and they pursued the next piece of the research with the thought extinct Latrodectus Aeternum spider. While Jess was outraged Michael didn't warn her about Octavia Vermis, he defended his position with the need for finding a cure for his daughter being a priority. After mentioning how her son is, the building was besieged and Michael's doctor Stephen took Rebecca hostage for the Aeternum spider. Once Rebecca was safe, he directed Jess to his private jet, which he and Jess piloted to a new destination. Once safe, Jess found Wundagore Mountain and was greeted with their mother, Miriam Drew. After Miriam appraised Jess of how things came to be, their location was compromised by an attack from Octavia and her L.M.D. army., during which Miriam turned on Jess and revealed herself as a clone. The Drew women brawled across the base until Michael used the Spider formula to boost Jess' strength. The fight was interrupted as Octavia took Rebecca, forcing Miriam to sacrifice herself as Michael escaped with Rebecca by Jess' escort. Safe outside, Michael admitted to having known Miriam was already a clone, being desperate for any route to cure Rebecca. He parted ways with Jess on strained terms, but both promised to find a cure for their condition. ===A Very Bad Choice=== After Jess handed Michael a copy of the cure array file, he tested it on his secretary (and lover), Rose Roché, granting her spider powers similar to Jess. But the medical information was promptly corrupted by a failsafe on their floppy disk that destroyed all data. To recover the data, Rose hired mercenaries to recover the original file, but Jess found out and confronted Michael to learn the truth. Jess returned afterwards as Spider-Woman to destroy the machine, but Michael used the array on himself with his serum as a catalyst. Developing his own set of spider powers, Michael became vehemently aggressive towards Jess, overpowering her and blaming his woes in life on her. Despite Rebecca's arrival pleading mercy, he ignored her and renamed himself Aeturnum. Rose then mind-controlled Jess with her pheromone powers to take Rebecca and fly a helicopter rigged to explode. The two women managed to escape, but ran into Rose and Michael again at his apartment. Still blinded by the effects of the serum, an augmented Michael fought Jessica while Rose handled Rebecca, but the heroic ladies were victorious as Jess knocked Michael unconscious and Rebecca injected Rose with a serum that removed her powers. As the villainous duo was escorted away by company security, Rebecca told Michael that she'd leave him some money on his bank account to get as far away from her as possible. His parting words were tearfully apologetic, realizing she was perfect just the way she was. ===New Life of Villainy=== Following his and Rose's exile, they were approached by Octavia Vermis and joined the Anti-Arach9, a supervillain team squarely focused on eliminating Spider-Woman.
fields.personality: While a business professional and capable pharmacist, his love for his daughter's wellbeing is an overwriting mentality to the point where he compromised Spider-Woman's own radiation immunity just to find a cure for Rebecca's illness. He is shown to be cooperative and willing to adapt to a situation, such as when he helped Jess recuperate and flee to Wundagore.
powers: Just like his sister, Michael was also able to attack by projecting electrical energy.
weaknesses: Michael is extremely suggestible around Rose, doting on her every command from her pheromonal manipulation of his mind. From her sway, he'll rationalize anything in the context of maintaining his daughter's welfare.
fields.trivia: Michael bears a resemblance to his nephew from Earth-20368.

michael marko.origin: Michael "Man Mountain" Marko was a street thug living in New York City, on day like any other he and his gang spotted someone to harass. The ordinary looking teenager was none other then Peter Parker. Peter was distracted by his Aunt May's illness, just knocking Marko away like he was nothing. It was from that day that Marko began his quest to gain powers. His first step was to become bodybuilder and to take work as a bodyguard. Man Mountain Marko joined the Maggia, and they fulfilled his wish, enhancing his body through genetic engineering. Using his new found strength he became the loyal lieutenant to Silvermane. He was sent by Silvermane to steal the Lifeline Tablet taken by the Shocker. He was confronted and defeated by Spider-Man. He then threatened Curt Connors until the scientist agreed to work with Louis Wilson to crack the ancient tablet's secret code. When Silvermane drank the elixir of life, made with the tablet's formula, Marko was at first deceived by Caesar Cicero into thinking that the young man was an impostor; nevertheless, when Spider-Man busted in the Galby Building, he tried to protect his master, but he was easily defeated again. Marko later targeted Big Ben Donovan, who went to the Heroes for Hire for help. He crashed into the office followed by Marko. He managed to knock out Luke Cage when their fight exposed live electrical wires which Marko used electrocute him. He took them both to Caesar Cicero, who wanted Donovan to reveal the location of stolen drugs while preparing Cage to be buried alive. However, Iron Fist arrived and defeated Marko and saved Cage from his fate. Marko was sent to free Hammerhead from a prison transport protected by the Heroes for Hire. Marko along with the Eel were easily matched against the heroes. However Luke and Danny traded partners, pitting the Eel against Luke, and Man Mountain against Iron Fist, the Heroes for Hire managed to beat their foes. Hammerhead crashed into the prison wall and was arrested. He teamed up with Nightshade, Stiletto, Discus, and the Eel to kidnap Jeryn Hogarth's daughter but were stopped by the Heroes for Hire. Marko obsession with becoming more powerful lead to him using horse steroids. He collected protection money for the Maggia when he went a bit crazy. He trashed an entire bar with Spider-Man inside. Ben Urich told Spidey that Marko took off after kidnapping a kid. Spider-Man learned the truth about the steroids. He tracked Marko to his home but he got the the better of Spider-Man as they fight at first but he tires and Spider-Man fights back and knocks him out. Meanwhile, the 'kidnapped' boy was just a fan of Marko's who wanted to be as big as him. Marko was hired by Mr. Zoumas to kill the private detective Jessica Jones. He attempted to strangle her, but Jessica easily defeated him. She dumped the unconscious body of Marko at the feet of Mr. Zoumas during his golf game. They were both the arrested by Agent Clay Quartermain of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Marko tried to quit his life of crime and became a relatively successful singer, even touring Europe. On a flight back to the United States, Marko got drunk and harassed the other passengers. Dazzler was also on the same flight. She used her powers against him to no avail, and threatening a stewardess, he forced Alison to sing. The song did not calm him, so she used her powers again knocking him out. Marko later joined Hammerhead's group who planned to take advantage of the upheaval during the Civil War. However their base was raided by Iron Man and S.H.I.E.L.D.. After Norman Osborn became head of H.A.M.M.E.R., he offered Marko a job as an ATF agent. He was tasked with hunting down the Agents of Atlas. However he was no match for Namora and was teleported to a desert by the Uranian. At another mission to the Temple of Atlas one of the ATF members went rogue, but when Marko confronted him, he revealed that he was Jimmy Woo. The Agents of Atlas attacked and Marko fled, frightened of Namora. He hid but was found by Mr. Lao and the giant dragon who swallowed Marko whole. Marko somehow survived and resurfaced as part of Boomerang's Sinister Sixteen. right|thumb Man Mountain Marko was hired by Cecelia Monroe to guard the hospital room of her daughter Tempest. Tempest's boyfriend, Miguel O'Hara, attempted to bribe his way into the room and Marko responded by throwing him into the stairwell. Marko checked the stairwell and assumed Miguel had took off, but when he returned to Tempest's room, he found Miguel in his Spider-Man guise. Believing him to be the original, Marko attacks Miguel. Their fight ended when Marko threatened to kill the babies in the nursery unless he left. Marko returned to the room to find it empty, realizing that their battle was just a diversion. Marko was tracked down by Spider-Man, who was looking for information on Cecelia. He claimed he never heard of her, until Spider-Man started breaking his fingers, then he eagerly told him her home address. He briefly got the upper h

fields.notes: Marko at one point implies he has committed (or would at least be willing to engage in) necrophilia; while trying to fatally strangle Jessica Jones, he exclaims, "Best part of these work-for-hire gigs? Is that after I'm done with you here--I don't have to hand you over... after I'm done with you, I can take your lifeless body out somewhere remote and I can do whatever I want with you. Then you'll really find out why they call me Man Mountain Marko". Marko claimed to have a son whose birth mother had hid from him for multiple years, but it was later stated that the child he's been separated from is a girl. It's possible that he was mistaken about his child's gender the first time he mentioned it, or that his child transitioned. Or he may have multiple children from multiple partners who are keeping them away from him. Most likely though, it was the mistake/ignorance of the writer.
fields.trivia: After succeeding in giving Man Mountain Marko his powers, Maggia's strength enhancement and genetic engineering division continued working on improvements of the process they had used on Marko, to generate a "new model" with the same powers to a greater level, implemented in a dozen-of-so agents known as the Persuaders.

michael mccain.origin: ===Mutant Liberation Front=== Forearm was one of the founding members of the terrorist organization known as the Mutant Liberation Front (or MLF). One of their first missions under the leadership of Stryfe was to liberate the incarcerated New Mutants members Rusty and Skids. They broke them out of prison and the pair joined the MLF out of confusion (and, as later evidence showed, neural implants kept them there). Forearm continued to be a mainstay in the team's ventures, including fighting X-Factor and other heroes. Under the leadership of Cable, the New Mutants became the paramilitary organization known as X-Force and began to be more aggressive in their campaigns. In one such mission X-Force discovered a hidden MLF base and, while fighting Forearm, Reaper and other members of the team nearly lost their lives when Stryfe ordered the destruction of the base. Later, Garrison Kane stumbled upon Forearm, Wildside, and Sumo in the Canadian mountains and, after a brief scuffle, followed them through their teleportation portal, where he was tortured. After a series of supposedly unconnected art thefts (all of which were related to Apocalypse), Forearm and Reaper approached Mister Sinister on behalf of Stryfe and proposed a trade. In exchange for a genetic matrix (none other than the Legacy Virus which Stryfe owned), Sinister handed over the captive Cyclops and Jean Grey. In the end, all of the MLF members were taken into custody. ====Reignfire's Leadership==== Soon after, a tyrannical despot named Reignfire decided to restart the MLF. He broke Forearm, Reaper, Wildside, and Tempo out of prison and gave them their first mission: kill Henry Peter Gyrich. The MLF also picked up new members Locus and Moonstar. Their assassination attempt was foiled by X-Force. Locus and Sunspot become lost, but Feral defected to the MLF after having a heated discussion with Gyrich. The team left and was taught teamwork by Moonstar, as, at the time, their ranks were once again down to four--Moonstar, Wildside, Forearm, and Feral. During this time Forearm and Moonstar began to form a close friendship, as she saw something in him that was different from the other members of the terrorist outfit. During the time Moonstar was part of the team, Forearm ended up battling forces from the other-dimensional realm of Asgard. They had appeared due to Moonstar's past history with the realm. Sometime later Reignfire began to hunt down his followers, taking Wildside and Forearm out first. All would have been lost if not for X-Force and Locus teleporting in to stop Reignfire. ===Legacy Virus Data=== Next, the MLF traveled to Muir Island where they meant to steal the Legacy Virus data from Moira MacTaggert. While there, they learned about the Xavier Protocols, and decided to try and steal them. They were confronted by members of the super-team Excalibur. If not for the covert efforts of Moonstar, the mission would have been a success, but instead the team teleported away. The MLF once again tried to steal data on the Legacy Virus, this time from a government institution who was trying to manufacture their own strain of the disease. They infiltrated the building and took the scientists hostage. Again, through the sabotaging efforts of Moonstar, members of X-Force managed to enter the building in an attempt to stop them. However, three of the scientists revealed themselves to be Prime Sentinels and attacked. The two groups pooled their resources, but only X-Force, Moonstar, and Forearm managed to escape. The remaining members of the MLF were captured by operatives of Operation: Zero Tolerance. During their time together, Moonstar revealed to him that she had been an undercover agent for S.H.I.E.L.D. meant to infiltrate the organization and feed the government information. Feeling betrayed, Forearm parted ways with the team. ===Death, Resurrection, and Depowering=== When he surfaced next Forearm was part of a fighting championship in Madripoor called Bloodsport where superpowered opponents fought to the death. However, in an unfortunate turn of events, Forearm was killed during a fight with former Serpent Society member Anaconda, who broke his neck. However, he would later appear inexplicably, alive and well, again as a member of the MLF. In the events of M-Day, most of the world's mutant population lost their powers due to the Scarlet Witch. Forearm was among them. ===Back with the MLF=== Under unknown circumstances, Forearm regained his mutant powers and reunited with the Mutant Liberation Front. The team first attacked Fairview Medical Labs, blasting the X-Men Blackbird down from the sky and injuring several students. While battling Rockslide, Forearm revealed the laboratory was manufacturing a vaccine to wipe out the mutant gene. Polaris and Nightcrawler intervened, with X-23 slashing the members of the MLF into defeat. Forearm and the MLF, now led by Hope Summers, later ambushed the X-Men. Forearm was defeated by Multiple Man and taken into custody

During this time Forearm and Moonstar began to form a close friendship, as she saw something in him that was different from the other members of the terrorist outfit. During the time Moonstar was part of the team, Forearm ended up battling forces from the other-dimensional realm of Asgard. They had appeared due to Moonstar's past history with the realm. Sometime later Reignfire began to hunt down his followers, taking Wildside and Forearm out first. All would have been lost if not for X-Force and Locus teleporting in to stop Reignfire. ===Legacy Virus Data=== Next, the MLF traveled to Muir Island where they meant to steal the Legacy Virus data from Moira MacTaggert. While there, they learned about the Xavier Protocols, and decided to try and steal them. They were confronted by members of the super-team Excalibur. If not for the covert efforts of Moonstar, the mission would have been a success, but instead the team teleported away. The MLF once again tried to steal data on the Legacy Virus, this time from a government institution who was trying to manufacture their own strain of the disease. They infiltrated the building and took the scientists hostage. Again, through the sabotaging efforts of Moonstar, members of X-Force managed to enter the building in an attempt to stop them. However, three of the scientists revealed themselves to be Prime Sentinels and attacked. The two groups pooled their resources, but only X-Force, Moonstar, and Forearm managed to escape. The remaining members of the MLF were captured by operatives of Operation: Zero Tolerance. During their time together, Moonstar revealed to him that she had been an undercover agent for S.H.I.E.L.D. meant to infiltrate the organization and feed the government information. Feeling betrayed, Forearm parted ways with the team. ===Death, Resurrection, and Depowering=== When he surfaced next Forearm was part of a fighting championship in Madripoor called Bloodsport where superpowered opponents fought to the death. However, in an unfortunate turn of events, Forearm was killed during a fight with former Serpent Society member Anaconda, who broke his neck. However, he would later appear inexplicably, alive and well, again as a member of the MLF. In the events of M-Day, most of the world's mutant population lost their powers due to the Scarlet Witch. Forearm was among them. ===Back with the MLF=== Under unknown circumstances, Forearm regained his mutant powers and reunited with the Mutant Liberation Front. The team first attacked Fairview Medical Labs, blasting the X-Men Blackbird down from the sky and injuring several students. While battling Rockslide, Forearm revealed the laboratory was manufacturing a vaccine to wipe out the mutant gene. Polaris and Nightcrawler intervened, with X-23 slashing the members of the MLF into defeat. Forearm and the MLF, now led by Hope Summers, later ambushed the X-Men. Forearm was defeated by Multiple Man and taken into custody
