michele gonzales.name: Michele Gonzales
michele gonzales.origin: Michele is a lawyer and the sister of imprisoned NYPD Officer Vincent Gonzales. She represented her brother in court after his arrest for his involvement in the "Spider-Tracer Killer" conspiracy and was able to get a plea bargain for him for a lighter sentence. Later she turned up to take control of Vincent's apartment and met his flatmate Peter Parker, whom she first encountered after Peter unknowingly spent two months away in an alternate dimension with the Fantastic Four. Parker invited her to the wedding of his Aunt May Parker and Jay Jonah Jameson. After getting drunk, the pair ended up together in a one-night stand, which complicated their relationship. When the Chameleon took over Peter Parker's life he tried to repair things with Michele. Some time after her brother was released from prison, Michelle had moved back to Chicago, no longer needing to watch over his apartment. She said goodbye to Peter before leaving, admitting he wasn't as bad of a guy as she thought.
michele gonzales.bio: Michele is a lawyer and the sister of imprisoned NYPD Officer Vincent Gonzales. She represented her brother in court after his arrest for his involvement in the "Spider-Tracer Killer" conspiracy and was able to get a plea bargain for him for a lighter sentence. Later she turned up to take control of Vincent's apartment and met his flatmate Peter Parker, whom she first encountered after Peter unknowingly spent two months away in an alternate dimension with the Fantastic Four. Parker invited her to the wedding of his Aunt May Parker and Jay Jonah Jameson. After getting drunk, the pair ended up together in a one-night stand, which complicated their relationship. When the Chameleon took over Peter Parker's life he tried to repair things with Michele. Some time after her brother was released from prison, Michelle had moved back to Chicago, no longer needing to watch over his apartment. She said goodbye to Peter before leaving, admitting he wasn't as bad of a guy as she thought.
abilities: Deception: Michele is cunning and skillfully manipulative. : Michele has knowledge of Tae Bo kickboxing and claims to know Muay Thai.

michele march.name: Michele March
michele march.origin: Michele March was a CBS News journalist active in New York City. She covered the press conference where Captain America introduced his hotline at the Municipal Convention Center in Brooklyn (which was interrupted by the Flag-Smasher's attack), and later reported the start of the trial of criminal William Cross, alias Crossfire, from the steps of the New York County Courthouse, which was to have two Avengers as witnesses (but her report was interrupted when criminal band Death-Throws rescued Crossfire just before he entered the courthouse). March also hosted a TV press conference where Captain America publicly explained his then-recent and controversial actions in Switzerland, where he had shot a terrorist dead. After Spider-Man supposedly attacked a man named Buddy Corbett (Really, Spider-man had saved Corbett from being ran over by a truck, but his actions had been misunderstood by nearby people), March interviewed several two eyewitnesses and, due to time restrictions, decided to use a good-looking one who gave an unflattering depiction of Spider-man, contributing to Spider-man being enraged.

michele scicluna.name: Michele Scicluna
michele scicluna.origin: Michele Scicluna was Pete Wisdom's supervisor at Black Air, the British government agency that eventually eclipsed the Weird Happenings Organization. She introduced him to Excalibur when insisting they investigate the unrest in Genosha. Scicluna and Black Air were actually corrupt at the highest levels, working with the London Hellfire Club to eventually unleash a demon that fed on the madness of human souls from beneath the streets of the city. After Black Air was officially disbanded, Scicluna continued performing private black ops work with the likes of Black Tom Cassidy and the Shadow X-Men.

michelinie.name: Michelinie
michelinie.origin: In the past he was a member of a project called Tesla and said project sought to dominate the world. On the project was Chika Tanaka and two other scientists. The project was cancelled, but Michelinie got another chance at Zodiac and was involved in a machine capable of creating tornadoes. He was talking to Nanami Ota when Chika arrived and a tornado passed nearby which caused Michelinie to be taken to the hospital. Chika along with Namami were investigating when an armed Michelinie arrived and admitted being responsible for the tornadoes. Chika and Nanami fled and then Michelinie approached a tornado which ended up dragging him.

michelle.name: Michelle
michelle.species: Human with Inhuman lineage activated by a Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
michelle.origin: thumb|left|Michelle as she appeared before she underwent Terrigenesis Michelle was a student at the Ohio State University when the Terrigen Cloud appeared over the campus. She was with her fellow classmates which included Ulysses Cain, wondering if any of them could be an Inhuman. Once the cloud went through, Michelle underwent Terrigenesis and became encased inside a cocoon. After emerging from it, she was transformed into a flying red-skinned creature that attacked the crowd. Some time later, Ironheart confronted Michelle.
